raw.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe the right job should do more than strengthen your CV — it should challenge you, inspire you, and feel right every day. We connect experienced professionals with long-term, full-time remote roles where engineering excellence truly matters.
Our mission is to remove geographic barriers and match top talent with global teams building high-impact, mission-critical products. We partner with companies that value precision, ownership, and long-term growth, empowering our people to thrive both professionally and personally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to work in a truly remote-first environment.

About the Role

Important: Laravel-only experience is not qualifying — proven Symfony experience is mandatory!!!
We’re hiring a Lead PHP & Symfony Software Engineer to work on mission-critical backend systems where code quality, reliability, and accountability are non-negotiable. This role goes far beyond feature delivery — it’s about engineering craftsmanship, technical ownership, and building systems you can truly stand behind.
You’ll be part of a highly collaborative Agile team, working closely with product, QA, and other engineers across the full lifecycle — from ticket definition and design through testing, review, and production deployment. This role is ideal for someone who values clean architecture, Test-Driven Development, thoughtful technical decisions, and mentoring others while building robust, scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality backend systems using PHP and Symfony
  • Own features end-to-end, from ticket creation and technical design to production release
  • Write clean, strongly-typed, maintainable, and testable code that meets strict quality standards
  • Apply design patterns thoughtfully and consistently
  • Build and maintain comprehensive automated test coverage using PHPUnit and similar tools
  • Follow and promote Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices
  • Use static analysis, linters, and code quality tools to ensure reliability and consistency
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams to deliver robust solutions
  • Break down complex initiatives into well-defined, actionable tasks and guide implementation
  • Monitor systems and participate in a rotating on-call schedule when required
  • Promote secure coding practices and ensure code is free from known vulnerabilities
  • Document architecture, decisions, and processes to support team-wide knowledge sharing
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience with PHP (7.4 / 8+)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Symfony framework
  • Strong understanding and practical use of design patterns
  • Solid experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Behat, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools (PHPStan, Psalm, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, code coverage, and deployment workflows
  • Excellent technical communication skills and ability to explain and defend technical decisions
  • High ownership mindset and strong sense of accountability

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working with MongoDB
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, React, Node.js, and/or TypeScript
  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
  • Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems

Benefits

  • Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  • No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  • Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  • Support That Matters: Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  • True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

raw.description:
As a Clinical Outreach Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical bridge for high-risk patients, utilizing your clinical expertise to navigate the critical window between hospital discharge and home recovery. In this high-impact, telephonic role, you will perform complex medication reconciliations, identify looming clinical red flags, and proactively close care gaps to prevent unnecessary ER visits and readmissions. By blending empathetic patient education with data-driven population health tools, you will empower patients to manage their health effectively while collaborating directly with primary care practices to ensure no one falls through the cracks of the healthcare system.
We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones.

Primary Duties

    Patient Outreach & Coordination:

  • Conduct targeted patient outreach to address and close care gaps, ensure timely care transitions, and immediate follow-up as needed. Daily responsibilities will include both inbound and outbound calls.

  • Deliver high-touch engagement for high-risk patients to prevent readmissions through post-discharge follow-up, medication reconciliation, and care coordination (i.e. Labs, screenings, and follow-up appointments).

  • Document interventions, assessments, and medication reconciliation across multiple EHRs while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

  • Provide patient education and assess eligibility for concurrent programsPersistently address patient reluctance or hesitation through education, empathy, and active listening.

  • Meet and sustain performance metrics

    • Practice Collaboration & Relationship Management:

  • Collaborate with Practices to support interventions such as Transitional Care Management (TCM), Osteoporosis Management in Women (OMW), ED follow-ups, and other care gap initiatives.

  • Serve as a clinical resource to foster collaboration and alignment with Aledade’s clinical programs.

  • Collaborate across teams to support patient engagement strategies and organizational goals.

  • Address challenges proactively, adapting strategies as needed and identifying areas for process improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Certificate or Diploma in Practical Nursing or Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN)

  • Current and unrestricted LPN license

  • Minimum of 2 years clinical experience in case management or discharge planning

  • Experience with telephonic patient outreach and clinical assessments

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage high-acuity cases

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Experience with electronic health records (EHRs) and population health tools

  • Critical thinking and clinical judgement in complex and rapidly changing environments

  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, evolving healthcare setting

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a remote environment

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license; Valid Compact RN license

  • Experience in Value Based Care

  • Certification in Case Management (CCM, ACM) or Care Transitions

  • Experience working with diverse and underserved populations

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

raw.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites. Our award-winning content and websites are created exclusively by us and directly for the use of millions of users worldwide. At Kodify, we're not just pushing boundaries in online entertainment—we're rewriting the script! Our goal is to empower our people with everything they need to pioneer innovation in our industry. Our culture is our secret sauce, and we're committed to preserving and enhancing it every step of the way.

Join our crew, where the Kodify team is not just an asset—it's our crown jewel. We prioritize their growth and well-being above all else, ensuring they're set up for success and always inspired to deliver their best work.

As a rapidly expanding company with diverse hubs across the globe and over 20 vibrant national cultures, working with us means embracing thrilling challenges tailor-made for a star Digital Asset Coordinator.

YOUR ROLE:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Content Coordinator to support our Content and Post Production teams. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working across multiple projects, keeping track of deadlines, coordinating with different teams, and ensuring that digital media assets are handled efficiently and accurately.

You’ll assist with the daily flow of content throughout the post-production pipeline—helping to organize, track, and distribute files, update records, and support communication between teams. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to creative processes.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project & Workflow Coordination

  • Track the status of various projects and assist in keeping schedules up to date.

  • Help maintain project timelines and organize task lists using tools like Smartsheets and Google Sheets.

  • Support communication between internal teams (production, post, web, systems) and outside vendors.

  • Keep clear and organized documentation of asset delivery, feedback, and updates.

Asset Handling & Distribution

  • Assist with receiving, organizing, and archiving production materials (video, audio, photos, hard drives).

  • Help retrieve and distribute raw assets and final deliverables to editors and other stakeholders.

  • Monitor and update storage systems (Dropbox, local drives) to ensure content is properly backed up and organized.

Quality Review & Delivery Support

  • Assist in reviewing final content for technical accuracy and brand consistency.

  • Help upload content and update metadata, images, and thumbnails in the content management system (CMS).

  • Ensure that assets are documented and shared with the appropriate teams in a timely manner.

General Support & Troubleshooting

  • Assist with locating archived files or resolving basic technical issues with media storage.

  • Help maintain records related to legal documentation and content delivery.

  • Support monthly DVD requests and assist with other project-related tasks as needed.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Generous training and development budget (10% of your annual salary)

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous PTO

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years with us!

  • 1 day off on your Birthday

  • Extended parental leave

  • Health and Wellness Budget

  • Health insurance

  • Cool and modern office space

  • Latest tech equipment

  • Healthy snacks and drinks provided at all times

  • Opportunity to travel internationally in Company retreats!

Requirements

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and stay on top of shifting priorities.

  • Proactive in providing updates and asking for clarification when needed.

  • Comfortable using tools like Smartsheets, Google Sheets, Dropbox, , Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Basic understanding of digital media formats (photo/video).

  • Familiarity with asset storage or archiving systems is a plus.

  • Must be able to lift 30+ pounds when handling physical media or equipment.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to post-production or content workflows.

  • Interest or experience in media, entertainment, or creative industries.

  • Enjoys organizing systems and streamlining processes.

AI Solution Architect

Who We Are:

BMO’s North American Commercial Banking serves clients across North America, where commercial bankers are trusted advisors and partners to their clients, delivering sector and industry expertise, local presence, and a full suite of commercial products and services.

BMO North American Commercial Bank is looking to build out its AI capabilities to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that enhance how our teams serve clients, make decisions, and execute complex banking processes.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work with business, product, data, AI, and technology leaders to design end-to-end AI solutions for transformational Commercial Banking use cases, with a particular focus on agentic AI journeys, machine learning, and intelligent workflow automation.

In this role, you will translate complex Commercial Banking business journeys into scalable AI solution architectures. You will develop a strong understanding of the business process, users, decisions, data, systems, controls, and handoffs involved, and design how AI agents, machine-learning models, data services, applications, and human interactions come together to deliver the end-to-end journey.

You’ll provide architecture leadership across the full AI solution lifecycle, from business problem definition and solution design through development, integration, deployment, and production readiness. This includes defining agent responsibilities and interactions, orchestration patterns, data and knowledge requirements, model and tool integration, human-in-the-loop controls, system interfaces, and appropriate guardrails.

You'll work closely with business partners, AI/data science teams, data engineering, software engineering, architecture, security, risk, and platform teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, scalable, reusable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

You’ll also lead the solution design for one or more AI initiatives, guide technical teams through architecture and implementation decisions, evaluate technology choices and trade-offs, and ensure consistency across multiple agentic journeys. You will help establish reusable architectural patterns that accelerate delivery across Commercial Banking while keeping abreast of emerging developments in Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, cloud platforms, and enterprise AI architecture.

Qualifications:

  • Strong experience designing end-to-end enterprise AI solution architectures, including integration across business applications, data platforms, APIs, AI/ML services, and cloud technologies
  • Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI architectures, including multi-agent orchestration, agent/tool interaction, workflow and state management, event-driven patterns, human-in-the-loop design, knowledge retrieval, and AI guardrails
  • Experience translating complex business processes and user journeys into scalable technical and solution architectures
  • Strong understanding of machine learning and Generative AI concepts, including predictive modeling, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, model evaluation, and the AI/ML lifecycle
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Python and SQL, with the ability to work effectively with AI, data science, data engineering, and software engineering teams
  • Experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from business challenge and architecture through development, integration, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing evolution
  • Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns including APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging, workflow orchestration, and integration with systems of record
  • Experience designing AI solutions with appropriate consideration for security, privacy, responsible AI, model risk, resiliency, observability, and enterprise controls
  • Strong business stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to lead solution design across multidisciplinary teams and provide technical direction and mentorship to architects, engineers, data scientists, and AI practitioners
  • Experience in financial services, with Commercial Banking domain knowledge considered a strong asset, including familiarity with areas such as lending, underwriting, credit, onboarding, relationship management, treasury and payments
  • Ability to balance business value, user experience, technical feasibility, risk, cost, scalability, and time-to-market when making architecture decisions
  • 10+ years of relevant experience across financial services, AI/ML, solution architecture, data, or software engineering
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field such as computer science, engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, or a related discipline
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, Generative AI platforms, and modern AI/ML development technologies would be considered a plus

$120,000.00 - $250,000.00

Salaried

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

Account Manager/Cardiology Education Specialist

The primary responsibility of this role is to deliver exceptional sales and service to end-users of Corcym's Heart Valve product line. The incumbent will be accountable for setting and meeting sales goals in terms of units sold and revenue generated across designated territories. Continuous assessment of market dynamics, reporting on market trends, and devising effective strategies for the assigned territory will also be integral to the role.

The second responsibility of this role is to promote and provide technical and clinical presentations of our products to hospital cardiologists.

The candidate should speak about our products, but also about therapies (SAVR Vs TAVR) and present the real world evidence and provide unbiased messages.

As an ideal candidate, you will have recent exposure to the clinical field and/or experience with the sales of medical devices to deliver clients quality service. You are willing to learn and work to maintain amicable relations with current clients, as well as grow accounts in the assigned territories.

Essential Functions

  • Attain sales targets for both volume and revenue, as well as pricing objectives.
  • Achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) aligned with corporate goals.
  • Continuously assess the market landscape in assigned areas, regularly reporting market insights and trends to management.
  • Regularly propose sales objectives and strategic initiatives to management, supported by written reports and recommendations.
  • Formulate promotional initiatives such as symposia, seminars, and webinars to drive sales goals in designated territories.
  • Ensure adherence to company compliance policies and ethical standards in all sales and marketing endeavours.
  • Maintain frequent customer engagement through product education, sharing clinical evidence, and regular visits.
  • Uphold the company's image and visibility within assigned territories through consistent customer interactions, attendance at trade shows, and engagement with surgeons.
  • Manage consignment inventories in accordance with company policies.
  • Provide timely submission of monthly sales reports, expense reports, account profiles, and other required documentation.
  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of the sales database through continuous updates.
  • Prepare necessary reports and customer presentations as needed.
  • Effectively manage territory expense budgets.
  • Organization of referral meetings.
  • Creation or reinforce a network between surgeons and cardiologists.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and adept at managing multiple tasks concurrently.
  • Proficiency in sales techniques and strategies to optimize revenue growth.
  • Demonstrates professionalism in attire, communication, and customer service etiquette.
  • Capable of articulating thoughts effectively and fostering professional connections.
  • Strong proficiency in both written and verbal communication.
  • Competent in operating personal computers and utilizing company software.
  • Skilled in using spreadsheet, graphics, word processing, and other business applications.
  • Flexible availability for travel and willingness to work beyond regular hours, including being on-call.
  • Proficiency in the English language.
  • Car driving license

Education & Experience:

  • Essential experience includes working within the Medical Device industry, preferably with Cardiovascular-related business.
  • Experience in the hospital operating theatre environment.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Understanding and application of compliance topics.
  • Strong history of leading and motivating teams to develop and implement commercial growth strategies in a matrix environment.
  • Exceptional customer focus with ability to build relationships.
  • Proven strategic selling skills necessary to achieve growth and sales objectives.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and relationship management skills, coupled with strong leadership abilities.
  • Proficient in negotiation and communication, with a talent for influencing and building trust.
  • 3 years of experience working within the Medical Device.

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

raw.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

Delivery | Remote, US | Full-Time | NAM

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll be embedded within our most critical clients, working inside their team, their systems and their data. You'll be the connection between what the client needs and the full expertise of the BPX team, deploying BPX capabilities across marketing, content, CRM and data, with AI and agentic workflows behind them. You'll work in quick iterations: a first release live in weeks, then improved with each cycle, until the client depends on it daily. This is a role that rewards judgment as much as skill: knowing what is worth deploying, and saying no to what will not pay back.

What you'll do

  • Embed with critical clients, working inside their team, their systems and their data, owning work they rely on daily.
  • Deploy BPX capabilities across marketing, content, CRM and data, directly in the client's platforms.
  • Work in quick iterations, shipping a first release fast, learning from real usage and improving each cycle.
  • Make it hold at volume, building in evaluation, guardrails, monitoring and cost control from the start.
  • Pull in the right specialists, spotting what the client needs next and bringing the wider BPX team in to deliver it.
  • Turn wins into accelerators, feeding patterns and components back into BPX-OS for other engagements to reuse.

What you'll bring

  • Technical fluency across the front office stack, enough to deploy and configure directly in client systems
    • Hands-on AI and agentic workflow experience in live client work, running in daily use.
    • Rapid deployment instincts, comfortable shipping a first version fast and improving it in the open.
    • Client-facing confidence, working directly with operators and executives and adjusting as you learn what blocks them.
    • Commercial judgment to know what is worth deploying and to say no to work that will not pay back.
    • Comfort with ambiguity, moving from problem to live deployment without a fixed spec to follow.

Why this role, why now

Our most critical clients are asking BPX to work embedded, at their side, on the problems that decide their year. This role is where that happens. You'll see your work live within weeks, with real autonomy over what gets deployed next.

Additional information

Anticipated base salary range: [$280,000-$320,000.

Benefits include medical insurance, 401(k), PTO, sick leave and remote working.

Equal Employment Opportunity. Bluprintx is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

Disability Accommodation. Bluprintx endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability to use the online application process, please contact with your specific accommodation request.

Work Authorization. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Bluprintx does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of citizenship or immigration status in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA).

raw.description:
The Medical Billing Specialist is a remote position with requirements to be located within 2 hours drive from Shepherdsville, Kentucky.

Overview

The Medical Billing Specialist ensures the accuracy of medical coding, posting payments, and balancing client accounts. We are looking for a routine task oriented, quick learner who treats our patients and staff with the utmost respect and “customer love”. If you are a certified coder, who enjoys working methodically and accurately, this is the job for you.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Daily interaction over the phone with patients/customers to answer questions or receive payments.
  • Daily posting of insurance payments and balancing deposits.
  • Assisting team members with billing and insurance questions.
  • Investigating and resolving denials and appealing the denials
  • Daily phone interaction with insurance companies to resolve issues with payments.
  • Coding during peak seasons.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills by phone or in person
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, and Workers’ Compensation insurance billing guidelines.
  • Knowledge of Electronic Medical Records.
  • Previous experience with claims, payment posting, denials, appeals and coding.
  • This is a "work from home" position and therefore, you must be able to work full days with no interruptions.

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Certificate in Coding preferred
  • At least two years coding experience required

Physical Requirements:

  • Constant periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Constant use of hands for typing.
  • At least 50% of the day requires speaking by phone.

Over the past 15 years, Mercy Urgent Care patients have returned to our clinics to seek fast, friendly, quality care. We take pride in our amazing customer love shown to our patients. We communicate respectfully creating a positive patient and work environment because we treat each person as a child of God.

We are eager to speak with you. Visit our website to get to know us a little better: www.mercyurgentcare.com.

Position Overview

  • Work hours: 8 hours - Monday through Friday
  • Benefits: Health, Life, Dental, Vision Insurance; 401k with match; Volume bonus plan benefit
  • Location: Remote - within 2 hours of Shepherdsville, KY

Join our Billing team by applying today. We look forward to meeting you!

Job Description Summary

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) for Surgical Innovations (SI) will be a globally experienced leader accountable for leading technology & innovation across the global $1+billion revenue SI business, which consists of 3 global R&D sites (US, China and Denmark). This leader brings a strong balance of strategic direction and engineering excellence and will collaborate closely across the SI business to deliver innovative products, next generation growth platforms, and solutions to differentiate GEHC SI in the market. Additionally, the ambition to create clinically meaningful, technically credible and commercially scalable solutions potentially not available in markets today will be critical to the role.
The CTO will shape clinical problems, customer value proposition, technology concept, external ecosystem and pathway to productization before detailed NPI execution begins. The role will be a visible and inspiring technology leader who brings both Engineering organizations and their leaders behind a common vision, while leading through a focused team and matrix influence.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Drives results and delivers by focusing on operating rigor on the critical few cascading and aligned KPIs
  • Cultivates innovation with a long-term view of the future of the industry, a keen understanding of how value will be created in the future, and a clear vision of how to generate sustainable competitive advantage
  • Aligns & partners with AIS CTO & other segment CTOs on enterprise technology strategy aligned with priorities and market trends.
  • Be proficient in the application of Lean Product Development concepts to Engineering organizations (inclusive of concurrent engineering, knowledge management, and product costing principles); apply Lean principles to increase design efficiency and direct proactive cost management on NPIs.
  • Drives budget control, engineering organizational design, technology differentiation, functional excellence and teamwork.

Early - Stage Innovation and solution vision

  • Own the SI early-stage innovation and potential market-creation agenda, with a clear focus on opportunities that utilize C-arm imaging and/or intraoperative ultrasound to improve surgical decision-making, navigation, visualization or workflow.
  • Identify unmet clinical needs and emerging workflows through direct engagement with surgeons, clinical experts, hospitals, academic centers and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Translate clinical insight into a compelling solution thesis: target use cases, customer value proposition, differentiated technology concept, adoption pathway and strategic rationale for SI.
  • Build and maintain an evidence-based opportunity funnel, including market and competitive intelligence, technology feasibility hypotheses, business potential, regulatory considerations and key adoption barriers.
  • Make clear choices about which opportunities to pursue, partner, mature or stop, and create decision-ready recommendations for the SI leadership team.

Technology leadership across Surgery and SVG

  • Bring deep technical understanding of intraoperative medical imaging, including their clinical applications, workflow constraints, system architectures, data and image requirements and integration opportunities.
  • Create a shared technology narrative, common problem definition, critical interfaces, feasibility experiments and technology choices together with the Surgery and SVG Engineering leaders
  • Lead cross-functional ideation, envisioning and technical concept sessions that bring together Engineering, Clinical, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, Quality and Regulatory expertise.
  • Mobilize the existing Engineering organizations through influence, clarity and inspiration rather than by building a large standalone technology team.
  • Formulates the strategy for continuous improvement of systems, products and processes related to our products and how they fit into our supply chain and services. This includes driving continued efficiency & transformation through the use of AI in R&D.

Clinical strategy and focused team leadership

  • Lead a small, team focused on clinical strategy and/or Business Development and Product Management Innovation.
  • Establish a strong voice of the clinician and customer in the innovation process, using structured discovery, workflow observation, clinical advisory input and early concept validation.
  • Create an environment in which technical experts, clinicians and commercial colleagues can challenge assumptions, learn quickly and build commitment to a shared future state with common goals. Solicits diverse inputs and creates a safe space for exchanging and incubating ideas. Ensures that the organization has the talent required to meet current and future business needs.
  • Coach and develop the focused team, while creating clear interfaces with the two Engineering organizations and the broader SI leadership team.
  • Builds a world-class engineering team by engaging in recruitment, retention, talent acquisition and development, and mentoring.

External ecosystem and strategic partnerships

  • Act as a credible external face for the SI technology vision in discussions with surgeons, hospitals, academic institutions, technology companies, start-ups and other potential partners.
  • Identify, evaluate and develop strategic partnerships that can accelerate clinical insight, technology capability, evidence generation or access to new markets.
  • Lead external envisioning and co-creation discussions, define the potential contribution of partners and work with Business Development, Legal, Quality and Regulatory teams to progress viable opportunities.
  • Represent SI at selected conferences, industry events, research forums and customer discussions, communicating the vision with credibility and energy.

From validated concept to productization

  • Work with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Services, Quality, Regulatory, Operations and Engineering to shape long-term solution roadmaps, business plans and investment cases.
  • Define the evidence, technology maturity, clinical value and business conditions required for a concept to move into productization.
  • Prepare a clear handoff to the appropriate Product Management, Engineering and Program leadership once an opportunity has reached productization readiness, while continuing to provide strategic technology sponsorship.

Inspiring leadership and culture

  • Create belief in a shared Surgery and SVG future and bring people along across organizational, functional and geographic boundaries.
  • Build trust between the two Engineering organizations by making the clinical purpose, strategic choices and decision rights transparent.
  • Model curiosity, constructive challenge, customer focus and disciplined experimentation, balancing breakthrough ambition with evidence-based choices.
  • Drives a culture that ensures outstanding compliance and adherence to product safety, quality and compliance in all areas for the Quality Management System

Qualifications and requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in biomedical, electrical, mechanical or computer engineering, physics, computer science, medical technology or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • 15+ years progressive experience in R&D leadership and project management
  • Significant experience in medical technology, surgical technology, imaging, visualization or a closely related healthcare technology field, including experience in technology strategy or innovation leadership. Deep technical understanding of intraoperative medical imaging. The candidate must be able to engage credibly with senior engineers and clinicians on modality capabilities, limitations, workflows and integration opportunities.
  • A demonstrated track record of identifying and shaping early-stage market or solution opportunities before detailed product development or NPI execution.
  • Experience translating clinical or customer needs into differentiated solution concepts, technology roadmaps, business cases and productization decisions.
  • Experience building relationships with clinical leaders, academic institutions, technology companies, start-ups or other external partners, and converting those relationships into strategic opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence in a complex global matrix and to align senior Engineering, Product Management and commercial leaders around a shared direction.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, coaching, negotiation and executive presence, with the ability to make complex technology meaningful to different audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Design Assurance Engineer responsible for undertaking National Grid BP141 design assurance roles on a variety of National Grid projects. This role ensures that designs for a variety of installations, asset replacements, connection schemes and substation builds comply with National Grid technical specifications, engineering standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

The successful candidate will work closely with National Grid Project Teams, DNO’s & Contractors, to support the timely delivery of safe, reliable, and compliant designs.

Experience of the UK Electricity Transmission and/or Distribution System is essential for this role.

We are looking for all Design Assurance Disciplines;

  • HV Plant
  • Substation Civil
  • Protection & Control
  • Relay Settings
  • HV Cable
  • Overhead Lines
  • Commissioning Officer

Responsibilities

Design Review & Design Compliance Assurance Audit Report (DCAAR) acceptance:

  • Review and assess design submissions, ensuring compliance with National Grid, technical specifications, procedures and engineering standards.
  • Provide detailed feedback and recommendations to address design gaps, non-compliance, or potential risks.
  • Support completion of design pack DCAAR once all technical, safety, and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Engage in regular project design review meetings with a variety of stakeholders.
  • Coordination and technical interface with other design assurance engineering disciplines.

Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between National Grid’s Project Team and Contractor Design Teams regarding design matters.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including asset management, project delivery teams, and other engineering disciplines, to ensure design alignment with project objectives.
  • Participate in design coordination meetings, workshops, and technical reviews with contractors and suppliers.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

  • Identify potential risks related to safety, reliability, and performance in contractor designs and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure that Contractor Design Teams have incorporated appropriate risk mitigation measures.
  • Experience of implementing safety by design and CDM awareness.

Documentation & Reporting:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of design submissions, review comments and DCAAR acceptances in accordance with BP188.
  • Review technical reports and assurance documentation related to design pack submission.
  • Monitor performance related to design quality and compliance, providing feedback to management as needed.
  • Experience of working to a structured project design process and compliance with associated BP188 timescales to support the project.

Essential:

  • HNC or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Currently or previously held National Grid BP141 Design Assurance Engineer authorisation
  • Chartered Engineer status or working towards CEng accreditation
  • Proven experience in infrastructure design, design assurance, or technical approval within the Electricity Transmission and/or DNO sector.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical infrastructure, relevant to the specific assurance discipline.

Desirable:

  • Experience of producing, reviewing and approving designs for National Grid and/or Distribution Network Operator (DNO) projects.
  • Currently or previously nominated as SR188 Contractor Design Approval Engineer on National Grid projects.

Location:

Home based, with the option of working from Omnia offices (Stafford, Stockton Heath and Northallerton), as per project requirements. Must be willing to travel anywhere throughout the UK.

Working Hours:

Ideally full time but willing to consider part time staff positions.

Package:

  • Competitive Salary, plus discretionary bonus
  • Working hours of 40hours per week. All overtime payable or time off in lieu (your choice) should you work more than this
  • 22days holiday, plus bank holidays with an option to increase
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Workplace Pension
  • Death in Service
  • Company car scheme

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

We at EGIS are an Equal Opportunities employer and we recognise the value of a Diverse Organisation. EGIS appreciates all job applications. If you decide to apply for an opportunity at EGIS, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and everyone’s contribution as this builds our culture and means, if you work for EGIS, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

Established in 2012, Omnia Projects is a respected specialist in T&D engineering, project management and technical assurance. With over 110 staff the company has delivered critical infrastructure for clients including National Grid, helping to shape the UK’s evolving energy system.

Omnia Projects brings deep expertise across the full energy project lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through to commissioning and operation, helping clients navigate the growing complexity of the UK’s energy landscape. About:

The Rolex SailGP Championship is the most exciting racing on water, where anything can happen in short, adrenaline-fueled battles between national teams at iconic stadium destinations worldwide. Top athletes fly in identical high-tech F50 catamarans faster than the wind, at speeds in excess of 100km/h (60mph). Founded in 2018, SailGP is one of the world’s fastest-growing sports and entertainment properties, now in its sixth season.

SailGP is a global organisation with defined values that shape the culture of its team - Deliver Quality and Consistency; Evolve with Focus; Make it Count; Stand Together and Strike a Balance.

Summary:

The Race Promoter Manager (Halifax) is a commercially driven sales leader responsible for generating sponsorship & hospitality revenue and developing commercial partnerships around the Canadian Sail Grand Prix. The role will focus on identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities with Canadian and international brands, supporting the growth of SailGP's commercial presence in the Canadian market.

Working closely with the global commercial, event, marketing, and partnership activation teams, this role will own the sponsorship & corporate hospitality sales process from prospecting and relationship development through to negotiation and close. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the Italian sponsorship landscape, an established network of brand and agency relationships, and a proven ability to deliver against revenue targets. The role will also interact closely with the Canadian SailGP Team to ensure we are maximising commercial opportunity from the Canadian market.

Key Responsibilities:

Partnership Sales & Revenue Generation:

  • Develop and execute a sponsorship sales strategy for SailGP event in Canada to meet and exceed revenue targets.
  • Identify, prospect, and close new sponsorship and partnership opportunities across priority categories
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective partners, using CRM tools to track activity, manage opportunities, and forecast accurately.
  • Develop compelling, tailored sales proposals and presentations that communicate SailGP's unique value proposition and commercial opportunities.
  • Lead on the presentation of compelling SailGP Event propositions to key brands.
  • Support the global sales team in potential global partnership opportunities arising from the Canadian market
  • Work closely with the global corporate (hospitality) sales team to generate local hospitality interest and sales opportunities to complement the local market sponsorship process
  • Secure corporate bookings for event hospitality packages (for relevant local and global brands)

Market Development:

  • Present a strong understanding of the Canadian sports sponsorship and brand marketing landscape.
  • Identify emerging opportunities, category whitespace, and competitive dynamics within the market.
  • Support the Events team in identifying new inventory opportunities and partnership integrations
  • Represent SailGP at relevant industry events, conferences, and networking forums to build relationships, generate leads, and increase commercial awareness.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in sports sponsorship, commercial sales, business development, media sales, events, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering revenue.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full sales cycle and closing sponsorship or partnership deals
  • Strong knowledge of the Canadian sports, sponsorship, and brand marketing landscape.
  • Existing relationships with senior contacts across Canadian brands, agencies, and/or media partners.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly organized with strong pipeline management and forecasting skills.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across a fast-paced, international organization.
  • Passion for sailing, sport, entertainment, or premium/international brands a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

Location:

Halifax, Canada.

This role is offered on a contractor basis for an initial period of 12 months. The successful individual will be engaged as a contractor rather than as a permanent employee, with the engagement expected to run for the full 12-month term, subject to the agreed contractual terms.

SailGP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity, equity and inclusion.

raw.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $175,000 to $200,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

TOTAL COMPENSATION

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

raw.description:
At Melita, payroll is where trust is earned. We are an HR, Benefits, and Payroll outsourcing company that has served small and mid-sized employers for over 30 years, founded on a simple principle: help our clients succeed by innovating, serving, and supporting their HR, Benefits, and Payroll needs. Accurate, on-time payroll protects our clients' businesses and their employees' confidence, and we take that responsibility seriously.

The chief objective of the Payroll Analyst is to provide exceptional service, expertise, and support to the Payroll & Implementation teams.

This role will be directly responsible for identifying & implementing system configuration setup and changes needed to deliver our global payroll services to clients. This position reports to our Global Payroll Manager.

Job Responsibilities

  • Maintains fundamental knowledge of Melita's services and clearly articulates all areas of global payroll compliance and HRIS topics relevant to the implementation process and payroll service.
  • Partners with the Melita & HRIS Implementation teams to configure and test the Payroll, Time & Attendance, and Time Off modules for new implementation clients. Performs parallel payroll testing to ensure payroll code calculation & taxation are working as expected per payroll regulations.
  • Customizes payroll workflows in the Salesforce CRM technology for client as needed.
  • Loads client employee data to the payroll technology, completes paycheck history data mapping.
  • Temporarily processes global payroll for new clients as part of the transition from Implementation to ongoing support.
  • Backup US payroll support for new clients as part of the transition from Implementation to ongoing support.
  • Creates documents or recorded training resources to be shared with client admins, managers and/or their employees related to the Time Off and Time & Attendance modules. Maintains the master version of these resources and incorporates revisions submitted by the Global Payroll Manager following client training sessions.
  • Conducts timecard training with the client's managers and employees. Applies revisions to the training materials as needed following client sessions.
  • Partners with the Payroll team to set up new payroll codes such as new earning, deduction, and memo codes in the payroll technology. Updates workflows in Salesforce CRM as needed to ensure they are properly used by the payroll team. Ensures changes are tested.
  • Performs a review of client benefit plan setups as they relate to payroll, aligned to the client's plan year, verifying that deduction codes in the payroll technology are correctly mapped to each benefit plan and that tax treatment is applied accurately.
  • Performs a review of the client's employee handbook as it relates to payroll, aligned to the client's handbook revision cycle, verifying that hours codes are correctly mapped to time off policies in the payroll technology and identifying any new or revised time off policies requiring configuration.
  • Collaborates with the broader HR & Benefits teams.
  • Attends new client implementation kick off and weekly status meetings.
  • Attends weekly internal HRComplete Operations meetings.
  • Attends monthly Payroll & Implementation team meetings.
  • Partners with the Global Payroll Director and Payroll Services Managers to identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiency and streamline payroll processes.
  • Global & US payroll processing backup support as needed.

The successful candidate must possess these key competencies and credentials:

  • Genuine passion for customer service and commitment to building strong relationships.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrates ability to organize and prioritize.
  • Demonstrate high analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, time management and organization and teamwork.
  • Maintains stable performance and poise under pressure.
  • Ability to coordinate efforts across multiple internal and external parties to ensure a timely, high-quality outcome.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Business Administration, Finance, HR or related field or equivalent.
  • 7+ years US and Global payroll processing experience, including hands-on payroll implementation and system configuration experience.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll technologies, specifically ADP Workforce Now. Paylocity and Rippling experience is a plus.
  • FPC/CPP certification
