raw.title: SAP Basis Administrator
raw.excerpt: BridgePhase is a mission-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government.
raw.description:
BridgePhase is a mission-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government. We empower agencies to achieve meaningful outcomes through high-performing software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and platform modernization solutions delivered by collaborative teams focused on innovation, adaptability, and operational excellence. As a trusted partner, BridgePhase helps Federal organizations modernize critical systems, accelerate delivery, and achieve lasting mission impact.

Position Overview:

BridgePhase is seeking an experienced, self-driven SAP Basis Administrator to support the architecture, administration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise SAP systems and database environments. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, security, and availability of complex SAP landscapes while supporting system implementations, upgrades, migrations, and ongoing operational initiatives.

The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on SAP Basis administration experience, a strong understanding of enterprise database technologies, and expertise in managing SAP environments across cloud and traditional infrastructure. This role requires a proactive technical problem solver who can troubleshoot complex system issues, collaborate across technical teams, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of critical infrastructure initiatives from planning through successful implementation. This position requires candidates to be U.S. citizens who hold no additional citizenship. This is a fully remote role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the technical architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing administration of enterprise SAP systems and supporting database environments.
  • Provide hands-on SAP Basis administration, ensuring the performance, stability, security, and availability of SAP applications and infrastructure.
  • Design, maintain, and optimize SAP system landscapes across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Support the implementation, configuration, upgrades, and maintenance of SAP systems operating on Windows and Linux platforms with HANA, Sybase, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Develop and manage system maintenance schedules, including patching, upgrades, performance tuning, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Apply SAP best practices for database backup, recovery, system restoration, and business continuity to ensure data integrity and operational resilience.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and validation to support system availability and business continuity requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex SAP system and database issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions to improve system reliability and performance.
  • Provide technical leadership in resolving infrastructure challenges, optimizing system performance, and addressing critical operational issues.
  • Evaluate technical requirements and provide guidance on system architecture, integrations, and third-party dependencies within the SAP environment.
  • Support SAP environments hosted on cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Collaborate with engineering, quality assurance, customer support, professional services, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and support successful project delivery.
  • Manage change control processes, identify technical risks and dependencies, and develop mitigation strategies to ensure timely and successful implementation of system changes.
  • Communicate project status, technical issues, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership.
  • Contribute to the development, documentation, and continuous improvement of technical standards, operational procedures, and SAP administration best practices.
  • Support the continued modernization, enhancement, and optimization of enterprise SAP infrastructure and database systems.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, with 12+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in SAP Basis administration, including system installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of SAP architecture, system landscapes, operational requirements, and established SAP administration best practices.
  • Experience administering and supporting SAP systems running on Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience working with enterprise database platforms such as SAP HANA, Sybase, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting SAP system implementations, upgrades, migrations, and ongoing production operations.
  • Strong understanding of database backup and recovery strategies, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity practices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Understanding of cloud computing models, including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS).
  • Experience working with highly technical teams to manage complex infrastructure initiatives, troubleshoot system issues, and implement technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently investigate complex technical challenges, identify root causes, and drive effective resolutions.
  • Experience supporting change management processes, risk assessments, and technical project coordination.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly to changing requirements, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while maintaining a high standard of technical quality and accountability.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and hold only U.S. citizenship.

As with any dynamic technical environment, responsibilities will evolve based on customer and mission needs. We are looking for individuals who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership of new challenges as they arise.

A Note to Staffing Agencies and Recruiters: We appreciate your interest in partnering with BridgePhase! At this time, we are managing recruitment for this position internally and are not accepting submissions from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies. Thank you for your understanding!

About Our Company:

BridgePhase was built around one simple belief: People who love where they work build better solutions. We bring top-tier engineering talent to the Government to support the nation's most critical work. Our people are not only technically exceptional, they're energized to deliver the engineering excellence, culture, and accountability our Government deserves. We thrive on building modern, secure, resilient solutions that accelerate mission outcomes, eliminate legacy barriers, and enable Government organizations to deliver faster and adapt smarter to meet today's demands and tomorrow's mission – without compromise.

Our Benefits:

At BridgePhase, we invest in our people with benefits that support your life, reward your impact, and reflect what matters most – both on the job and beyond it. Employee benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation that reflects your skills and impact
  • Multiple bonus programs rewarding performance, company growth, and employee referrals
  • Flexible PTO with 20 days to use when you need them
  • All federal holidays paid to help you truly recharge
  • 7 paid sick days because health always comes first
  • 100% paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with 6% match and no vesting period
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision plans with low out-of-pocket costs
  • Short- and long-term disability and life insurance included
  • Pet insurance to support your four-legged family
  • Annual professional development budget for training, certifications, and conferences
  • Two paid community service days for causes that matter to you
  • Social pod budget to connect with teammates wherever you live

What We Can Achieve Together:


The Contracts Specialist II will understand their BUs’ delegations of authority and power of attorney structure, advise staff on who has authority to sign various agreements, be able to update the DOA list, and draft/issue new DOAs as needed. In addition, they will be able to navigate complicated authority issues with the Legal Department as necessary. The Contract Specialist II will supervise others’ compilations auditable files for all contractual agreements, interact with Internal Audit as necessary, supervise the BUs’ tracking systems, supervise systems used to remind Project or Award Managers about project deadlines, products, and payments. Trainings will focus on TNC contractual agreements and related processes. They will also be expected to serve as mentors to other CCSs. May supervise Contracts Administrators and Contracts Specialists. The Contracts Specialist II will also work closely with the Legal Department to develop new Standard Agreement templates, improve workflows, and more.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with strong experience in providing a full range of administrative support.

The ideal candidate should have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience in various contracts related tasks This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the ongoing mission of conservation by directing and shaping the work of our team!


What You’ll Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree and 3 years experience or equivalent combination;
  • Previous contracting experience, coursework, or dedicated training;
  • Organizational skills and experience with attention to detail;
  • Experience managing and implementing multiple projects;
  • Experience interpreting guidelines to achieve desired results;
  • Experience with business process analysis and/or improvement;
  • Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading;
  • Experience organizing time and managing various activities to meet deadlines; and
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams.

Desired Qualifications


  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experiences are appreciated;
  • Ability to implement complex processes;
  • Ability to analyze information for the purpose of preparing reports, coordinating activities, and solving problems;
  • Ability to apply research skills;
  • Ability to use existing technology to achieve desired results; and/or
  • Experience in supporting Financial and/or Legal processes.

Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $59,179-94,000. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.


Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

raw.description:
NetSPI+Synack is a leader in offensive security, combining elite human expertise with agentic AI to help organizations identify, validate, prioritize, and remediate exploitable risk across their entire attack surface. Its platform delivers expert-validated testing in depth, continuously, or on demand, from pre-production code to live production environments, so security teams can separate vulnerability noise from real risk, including the growing threat of AI-driven attacks. With global reach and more than 13 million hours of real-world offensive testing experience, NetSPI+Synack serves many of the world's largest enterprises and government organizations with one ambition: nothing left to exploit.

We are looking for individuals with a collaborative, innovative, and customer-first mindset to join our team. Learn more about our award-winning workplace culture and get to know our A-Team at and .

The Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a technical advisor and advocate, helping our customers achieve maximum value from our product and services.

You will have a deep understanding of penetration testing attack surfaces and a knack for developing unique solutions that align to customer goals. Your technical knowledge and client-focused approach enable you to scope and monitor penetration tests executed by our Synack Red Team (SRT). The Senior TAM partners with customers to ensure health and quality of engagements, as well as identify and articulate how our solutions can enhance their overall strategic security testing goals.

The ideal candidate will have experience in the cyber security industry, a consultative approach to working with customer stakeholders and a passion for customer advocacy. Sounds interesting? Keep reading...

Please note:We can only hire U.S. citizens for this position due to Federal Government contract requirements.

Here’s what you'll do

  • Develop the scope and rules of engagement of penetration tests, and direct researchers to effective testing
  • Use your consultative communication skills to gather requirements, understand customer needs, and influence internal/external stakeholders
  • Partner with internal teams to determine, develop, and analyze the client’s assets, such as:
    • Their digital attack surface and value at risk
    • Their existing vulnerability programs, tools, and methods
    • Their security program, including requirements and goals
  • Work independently and provide technical product expertise to build the appropriate solution for the client’s needs
  • Provide technical SME expertise to internal stakeholders and the client on their strategic goals and testing requirements
  • Proactively review assessment health to provide technical findings, vulnerability details, and insights to improve overall test quality/outcomes and mitigate risk
  • Assist customers in managing and optimizing their long-term pentesting programs, ensuring continuous security improvement and adaptability
  • Collaborate with the account and CSM teams to address any areas of concern or opportunities to expand to retain and grow client accounts
  • Collect and act on feedback from clients to continuously improve engagement and service offering
  • Responsibility for any technical escalations that may arise during the engagement

Here’s what you’ll need

  • At least 5-7 years of technical account management, technical project management, and/or customer success experience in the Cyber Security Industry or Technology Industry
  • Experience with vulnerability discovery management, risk management frameworks and associated business workflows, and remediation
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g. Python, Bash, Basic SQL) and developing scripted solutions to problems
  • A knack for explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • Relevant industry certifications in cybersecurity and/or security management such as, Security+, CISSP, CISA
  • Excellent time management, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills as well as the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects
  • Customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value
  • Proactive and solution-oriented approach to addressing client challenges
  • Ability to think strategically and provide innovative solutions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Candidates must be US citizens

Ready to join us?

Synack is committed to embracing diversity. Our people are our strength. Each addition to our team is an opportunity to grow and diversify our ideas, experiences, and viewpoints. Synack strives to be inclusive of all people.

As a candidate, Synack cares about your privacy. Please view our candidate privacy policy here.

This position has responsibility to ensure Synack’s security and privacy posture is maintained.

We are looking for highly skilled Mathematics Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving advanced mathematical problem-solving, computational mathematics, numerical methods, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating mathematical tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require translating a mathematical problem into a computational procedure, implementing the relevant equations or algorithms, calculating a reproducible result, testing special cases, and determining whether the final answer is mathematically and numerically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate advanced mathematical and computational problems.
  2. Translate mathematical requirements into precise, executable workflows.
  3. Implement mathematical workflows using Python and command-line-accessible tools.
  4. Use Python to automate calculations, numerical experiments, parameter sweeps, visualization, and result validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field; or
  2. A BS in Mathematics or a closely related quantitative field plus at least 1–2 years of mathematics-focused professional or research experience in top companies/institutions.
  3. Strong expertise in at least one mathematical area, such as applied mathematics, numerical analysis, optimization, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, algebra, geometry, mathematical modeling, or dynamical systems.

Relevant tools may include Python, SymPy, SageMath, SciPy, CVXPY, NumPy, GNU Octave, Julia, or similar programmatic mathematical software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, CVXPY, statsmodels, NetworkX, numerical solvers, optimization libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Principal TPM - GSO Studio Enablement

United States, Remote

Role Overview

Reporting to the Vice President of GSO and Studio Enablement, the Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) will serve as a key driver of strategy, execution, and organizational alignment across one of Sony Interactive Entertainment’s most critical technology domains. This role is an individual contributor with significant influence, operating at the intersection of engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

The Principal TPM will shape and advance initiatives across Global Service Operations and Studio IT, ensuring both organizations’ missions. The role requires not only deep technical program management expertise but also organizational design insight, executive-level communication, and the ability to foster alignment across leadership teams, operating companies, and external partners.

This is a high-impact role for a seasoned technical program leader who thrives in complexity, navigates ambiguity, and builds trust at all levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Translate GSO and Studio Enablement’s long-term strategy into clear execution roadmaps, working across engineering, product, and operations teams to drive delivery of mission-critical initiatives.
  • Anticipate and surface cross-organizational dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, guiding leadership decision-making with data, insight, and scenario planning.

Cross-Organizational Influence & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner closely with leaders across SIE engineering, product management, design, and operations to align priorities and unlock execution velocity.
  • Represent GSO and Studio Enablement in enterprise forums, ensuring that operations and studio IT capabilities are positioned effectively across Sony’s ecosystem.
  • Build trusted relationships with external stakeholders (partners, vendors, strategic alliances) to accelerate adoption of Studio IT capabilities and extend GSO value.

Execution Excellence & Governance

  • Drive program governance for our highest-priority initiatives, ensuring effective rhythm-of-business, transparent reporting, and predictable execution.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs for our programs, producing data-driven insights that inform leadership decisions and drive accountability.
  • Establish operating frameworks that simplify decision-making and improve organizational agility across multiple stakeholders.

Organizational Design & Enablement

  • Serve as a thought partner to team leadership, helping design and refine organizational structures, roles, and processes that enable sustainable growth.
  • Curate leadership offsites, reviews, and cross-functional planning forums that sharpen objectives and unify execution.
  • Champion modern engineering and program management practices (Agile, SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management) that enhance collaboration, delivery predictability, and organizational health.

Executive Communication & Storytelling

  • Craft clear, compelling communications (strategy narratives, board/executive briefings, external partner messaging) that connect our technical vision to business outcomes.
  • Elevate GSO and Studio Enablement’s voice across Sony and the industry by supporting leadership with thought leadership, positioning, and strategic storytelling.
  • Ensure visibility and alignment by producing high-quality reports, presentations, and narratives for executives across Sony’s operating companies.

Qualifications

Experience & Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in technical program management, portfolio management, or related roles in large-scale software environments.

raw.description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security

Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity

The short version: NetFoundry, the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.

Why this matters now:

AI broke the network security model.

Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.

NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.

Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.

We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

The role:

We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.

That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.

This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.

A note on leads: This is an outbound focused role. Marketing supports you with content, campaigns, and intent data. Pieline starts with you, on the phone.

What you'll do:

  • Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of enterprise accounts — you build the list, you work the list
  • Cold call. Daily. This is the core of the job, not a footnote
  • Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn, with real personalization rather than merge fields
  • Run discovery that surfaces real pain: firewall and VPN sprawl, exposed APIs, OT segmentation projects, AI agents that need access to sensitive systems
  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hit monthly and quarterly pipeline targets
  • Build account plans with AEs and multi-thread into security, networking, cloud, and platform teams
  • Act as our fastest feedback loop since you'll hear what the market says before anyone else. Leadership will change the messaging based on what you report.

What we're looking for:

  • Ambition to become an AE
  • 1–3 years in outbound SDR/BDR or inside sales, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology
  • A track record you can put numbers to - activity, meetings booked, pipeline sourced, quota attainment
  • Genuine willingness to cold call, and the resilience to do it on the days it isn't working
  • Strong written communication; you can write an email a CISO would actually reply to
  • Comfort with technical buyers, and curiosity to learn what a firewall rule, a service mesh, and an AI agent actually are
  • Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms (we run HubSpot)
  • Organized, coachable, and hard to discourage

Nice to have: Familiarity with Zero Trust or secure connectivity concepts; experience with open source or developer communities; account-based selling.

What you get:

  • A founding seat. You're among the first three SDRs at a company building a category, with direct access to GTM leadership and founders
  • A clear path to AE. Our SDR→AE path is 12-18 months for performers, and we'd rather promote you than hire around you
  • Competitive base with uncapped commission, plus meaningful equity — $60,000 base / $90,000 OTE (uncapped)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision, plus expanded well-being benefits
  • Employer-paid life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability
  • 401k with company match
  • Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
  • Learning & development budget, technology stipend, internet stipend, SWAG stipend
  • Remote-first with flexible hours, as a globally distributed team
Salary: $60,000 base/ $90,000 OTE (uncapped) + equity

SailPoint Engineering Lead, IAM

Location: Dallas, TX | Ashburn, VA | Denver, CO | Charlotte, NC | Boston, MA | New York, NY | Austin, TX ,and open for (Remote)

Your Role

You will serve as the internal owner and technical authority for Digital Realty's SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) platform, defining how identity governance operates at enterprise scale. This role leads the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) strategy, architecture, and delivery, ensuring access lifecycle management, certifications, and compliance controls are designed and executed to meet global regulatory and operational requirements. As the enterprise lead for SailPoint ISC, you will drive the evolution of Digital Realty's identity governance program while partnering across Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, and Business teams. This is not an execution role—it is a program leadership position with direct accountability for how identity governance operates across a globally regulated enterprise.

What You'll Do

  • Own and drive the multi-year IGA roadmap and strategy.
  • Define SailPoint ISC architecture across Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes, access certifications, role models, and connectors.
  • Design integrations with Oracle HCM, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, ServiceNow, BeyondTrust, and Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Build and deliver SailPoint ISC capabilities, including workflows, lifecycle rules, access requests, and certification campaigns.
  • Establish configuration-as-code practices utilizing GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated testing as the standard operating model.
  • Lead, mentor, and quality-gate offshore delivery teams.
  • Govern systems integrator (SI) partners and ensure deliverables meet architecture, security, and operational standards.
  • Own SOX User Access Review (UAR) campaigns, audit evidence collection, and compliance engagements.
  • Ensure identity governance controls align with regulatory requirements, including NIS2 and DORA.
  • Define and implement governance for non-human identities, including service accounts, APIs, machine identities, and privileged access integrations.

What You'll Need

  • 8–10 years of Identity and Access Management (IAM) experience, including 4+ years of hands-on SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (IdentityNow) experience.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes.
  • Experience owning enterprise IGA architecture and delivering multi-year roadmap initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in access certifications, SOX User Access Reviews (UARs), audit readiness, and compliance engagement.
  • Deep knowledge of non-human identity governance, including service account lifecycle management, NHI discovery and classification, PAM/IGA integration, and secrets management practices.
  • Experience operating identity governance programs within large-scale enterprise environments supporting 10,000+ identities.
  • DevOps mindset with hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and configuration-as-code methodologies.
  • Advanced SailPoint ISC technical expertise, including rules, APIs, connectors, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with Oracle HCM, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • SailPoint ISC Certified Engineer (or equivalent) strongly preferred; CISSP and/or CISM certifications preferred.

A Bit About Us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company's global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit digitalrealty.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

A Bit About Our Team

Technology & Innovation

Our Technology & Innovation team strives to innovate alongside our customers and empower their businesses to thrive. We work closely with our customers to develop insights-based, data-driven technical solutions and differentiated value propositions on PlatformDIGITAL® across the world. Operating in almost 50 cities globally means we understand how rapidly the world is evolving, so we've built a best-in-class development model to qualify, package, and enable cloud-to-core-to-edge hybrid IT solutions. Our deep technical heritage, combined with our global footprint, allows us to create and deploy services and solutions that are at the heart of the digital economy.

What We Can Offer You

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you'll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you'll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We'll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital Realty; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals—they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners, and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Compensation Range

$140,000 - $180,000 USD annually

Our published pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the full-time position determined by role, level, and geographical location. Individual pay is based on additional factors including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training. Moreover, an employee's total compensation package varies by role and may include salary, cash bonus, and equity awards not quantified below.

Benefits

For this role, benefits include medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) match, disability benefits, wellness and education benefits, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, holidays, and more.

raw.description:
Product Manager

VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Program | Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.)

The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve

Every month, your product decisions reach Veterans buying homes, the lenders who close their loans, the servicers who manage them, and the VA staff who stand behind the guaranty.

We are hiring a Product Manager for the modernization of the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) technology portfolio. The job is translation under pressure: statute, policy, and a sprawling stakeholder ecosystem on one side, a backlog that ships to production every 30 days on the other, while a 20-year-old legacy platform keeps running until the modern one replaces it. If you can hold the Veteran, the lender, and the regulation in your head at the same time, keep reading.

The Opportunity

Most product roles let you invent demand. This one hands you something rarer: a product whose demand is guaranteed by law, which means every ounce of product discipline goes into making the experience better instead of making the funnel bigger.

The LGY portfolio spans the loan guaranty lifecycle: origination-adjacent workflows, servicing oversight and loss mitigation, claims, housing grants, and analytics. The modern platform is Salesforce-centered and configuration-first, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud. Users include VA program staff and thousands of external lender and servicer users.

The rhythm is fast and formal. Business needs enter through an intake process that produces an executable plan, with refined scope and level of effort, in days. Development runs on a monthly release cadence with an explicit quality bar: acceptance criteria sharp enough to support automated testing, defect detection above 95% before user acceptance testing, and accessibility built into every story. Your requirements are the first link in that quality chain.

You will partner with an Enterprise Solution Architect who owns the designs, an Engineering Lead who owns delivery, and a DevSecOps Lead who owns the platform. You own what gets built, in what order, and why.

What You'll Own

  • The backlog as an instrument of the mission. Turn business needs and policy changes into refined, traceable user stories with acceptance criteria precise enough that engineers build the right thing and testers can automate against it.
  • Intake to executable plan, fast. Drive new needs from raw business intent to a scoped, estimated, committed plan in days, working shoulder to shoulder with architecture and engineering.
  • The roadmap across the portfolio. Sequence modernization, sustainment, and legacy decommissioning, and keep the roadmap credible enough that the customer plans against it.
  • A stakeholder ecosystem, not a stakeholder. Balance VA program officials, field staff, and external lender and servicer users whose interests do not always align.
  • Value in every release. Own prioritization so every 30-day release ships something stakeholders can name, and coordinate user acceptance testing that runs smoothly because the criteria were right from the start.
  • The configure-versus-customize conversation. The program mandates configuration-first solutions. You represent the business value side of those tradeoffs and know when to fight for a custom exception.
  • Decisions informed by data. Ground prioritization in analytics, usage, and operational metrics, and push for instrumentation where it does not exist yet.
  • The transition experience. As functions move from legacy to modern, sequence the change so lenders, servicers, and VA staff are brought along rather than surprised.

AI-Native Product Management

AI is part of how PhoenixTeam works, and product management may have more to gain from it than any other discipline on the program.

We are looking for someone who already uses AI tools as a working part of their practice: analyzing policy and regulation changes to extract requirements impacts in hours instead of weeks, drafting and stress-testing user stories before refinement, synthesizing stakeholder feedback into decision-ready themes, and keeping the backlog coherent as the portfolio grows.

Judgment stays human. You know when AI output misreads a regulation or produces acceptance criteria that sound precise but are not. And boundaries are non-negotiable: federal environments govern what tools may touch government data and systems. Use AI wherever it creates leverage, and understand the security, data, privacy, and authorization boundaries governing where and how it can be used.

What Great Looks Like

Twelve months in, we would expect to see:

  1. Intake is fast and trusted. Needs move from raw intent to committed plans in days, and the customer trusts the scoping because it keeps proving accurate.
  2. Requirements stopped causing rework. Stories flow into development without churn, and ambiguity-driven defects trend toward zero.
  3. Every release has a headline. Stakeholders can name what shipped last month and why it mattered.
  4. UAT is uneventful. The business was engaged all along, not summoned at the end.
  5. The roadmap is the plan of record, and it survives policy changes because you built it to flex.
  6. AI is visibly part of your practice, with policy analysis, story drafting, and feedback synthesis running measurably faster.

What You Bring

We care about evidence more than resumes. Expect us to ask which products you have shaped, what your requirements looked like to the engineers who built from them, and how AI functions in your practice today.

  • A product management record on complex enterprise software, with real users, real stakes, and outcomes rather than ceremonies.
  • Housing finance domain fluency. You can hold your own with business stakeholders on day one. Depth in servicing, loss mitigation, or claims is especially relevant.
  • Requirements craft. You write stories and acceptance criteria that engineers praise and testers can automate against.
  • Federal delivery experience. You treat accessibility, security, and documentation as product constraints to design within, not obstacles to resent.
  • Stakeholder range. You facilitate rooms spanning senior officials, field users, and engineers, and you can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship.
  • Evidence-driven prioritization, with stated assumptions when data is thin.
  • Demonstrated AI-in-the-loop practice you can show us concretely.
  • Judgment under ambiguity. You make the call, document the reasoning, and own the outcome.

  • U.S.-based, and able to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust clearance.

We do not screen on degrees or year counts. If your evidence is strong, we want to talk.

Helpful, Not Required

  • Direct experience with VA Loan Guaranty, VALERI, or other VA benefit programs.
  • FHA, USDA rural housing, or GSE experience, or lender and servicer operations on the commercial side.
  • Product work on Salesforce or a comparable configuration-first platform.
  • Familiarity with MISMO, URLA, Jira and Confluence, or scaled agile.

Leadership Expectations

This role leads through the product. You set direction that architecture, engineering, and the customer align around, present recommendations to federal decision-makers with evidence, and challenge direction that will hurt the program or the Veteran, respectfully and early, including ours. Silent disagreement is a failure mode here, and so is the PM who relays stakeholder requests without shaping them. When priorities conflict, you make the call and own the outcome.

This May Not Be the Role for You If...

You may struggle here if you need someone else to translate policy into requirements, treat product management as ticket administration, avoid telling stakeholders no, wait for complete information before committing, treat compliance as friction rather than product requirements, view AI as a novelty, or stopped learning when you became senior. None of that makes someone a bad product manager. It makes them a bad fit for this particular job.

Why PhoenixTeam

  • You will be among people who speak your language. PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business founded and led by housing finance technologists who still do the work, with years embedded inside federal housing programs from loan guaranty to rural housing to mortgage insurance.
  • Direct customer access. Your product judgment reaches the federal decision-makers who act on it.
  • You shape the product, not just the backlog. You define how product management works on this program.
  • AI-native is practice, not positioning. We fund ongoing AI education and development for the entire team.
  • Fully remote,S.-based, permanently.
  • Competitive salary and 100% employer-paid medical insurance.
  • Mission you can explain at dinner. The product you shape supports the home loan benefit for the people who served this country.

Position Requirements

  • Full-time W-2 employment with PhoenixTeam.
  • Must be based in the United States.
  • Fully remote.
  • Work supports the Department of Veterans Affairs Loan Guaranty Service (LGY).
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal Public Trust clearance. A Secret clearance is not required.

PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business focused on federal and commercial housing finance technology.

raw.description:
À propos d’Akinox

Akinox est une entreprise canadienne de santé numérique qui vise à améliorer l’accès des patients aux soins ainsi que la façon dont les organisations de santé les offrent. Depuis plus de 15 ans, Akinox collabore avec des organisations de santé et des gouvernements afin de concevoir et d’exploiter des solutions de santé numérique à grande échelle. Nos activités couvrent notamment les soins de première ligne, les soins virtuels, l’accès aux soins et la transformation des processus cliniques.

À propos de CarePath

CarePath transforme des informations cliniques fragmentées en une vue claire et exploitable du patient.

Conçu pour les équipes de soins de première ligne et de santé communautaire, CarePath utilise l’intelligence artificielle pour simplifier l’analyse des dossiers patients, repérer les informations cliniques clés et faciliter la préparation des soins. La solution vise notamment à réduire la charge administrative et clinique liée à l’accueil de nouveaux patients. CarePath entre maintenant dans une phase importante de commercialisation et de développement de sa clientèle.

Le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Coordonnateur(trice) junior – Développement des affaires et ventes pour soutenir la croissance de CarePath.

Il s’agit d’un contrat de 6 mois à 30 heures par semaine avec possibilité d’extension. La personne recherchée doit avoir un intérêt marqué envers les ventes, le développement commercial, et la technologie dans le domaine de la santé.

En étroite collaboration avec le Chief Growth Officer et l’Architecte de solutions ventes, vous contribuerez à identifier des clients potentiels, à réaliser des activités de prospection, à soutenir les activités de découverte et de vente ainsi qu’à assurer un suivi efficace des occasions d’affaires afin de les faire progresser.

Vos responsabilités

  • Effectuer chaque semaine de la génération de prospects et de la recherche de comptes assistées par l’IA, en fonction des profils de clients idéaux (ICP) définis.
  • Effectuer des recherches sur les organisations de santé ciblées et identifier les décideurs et personnes-ressources pertinents.
  • Créer et maintenir des listes priorisées de prospects et de démarches de prospection.
  • Effectuer de la prospection par courriel, LinkedIn et téléphone en utilisant les messages et campagnes établis pour CarePath.
  • Identifier et communiquer avec les prospects qualifiés ou ayant déjà démontré un intérêt, effectuer une première qualification et coordonner leur transfert à l’Architecte de solutions ventes pour approfondir la découverte des besoins et les discussions entourant la solution.
  • Consigner avec précision dans HubSpot les activités de prospection, les interactions avec les clients, les notes de rencontre, le statut des prospects et les prochaines étapes.
  • Participer aux activités de découverte client, notamment par la recherche sur les comptes, la préparation des rencontres, la prise de notes et les suivis.
  • Contribuer à la préparation et à la personnalisation de présentations de vente, documents synthèses, études de cas et autres outils de vente et de marketing.
  • Interagir avec les clients et les utilisateurs afin de recueillir des commentaires, résultats, données et observations pouvant être utilisés dans les activités de vente et de marketing.
  • Soutenir les webinaires, conférences, lancements de produits et autres activités de mise en marché, notamment en contribuant aux invitations et aux suivis.
  • Fournir au Chief Growth Officer une mise à jour hebdomadaire concise présentant les activités réalisées, les prospects, les rencontres, l’évolution du pipeline de ventes ainsi que les commentaires pertinents provenant du marché.
  • Participer à d’autres activités liées aux ventes, au développement des affaires et à la mise en marché, selon les besoins.

Profil recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste de début de carrière. Nous ne nous attendons donc pas à ce que vous connaissiez déjà tout du secteur de la santé ou de la vente aux entreprises. Nous recherchons plutôt une personne qui :

  • A minimalement un diplôme secondaire, est actuellement aux études (post-secondaire), récemment diplômée ou se situe approximativement dans les cinq premières années de sa carrière.
  • Est à l’aise de communiquer de manière professionnelle par courriel, téléphone et LinkedIn.
  • Est organisée et en mesure d’assurer un suivi rigoureux et constant des activités de prospection et des prochaines étapes.
  • Est à l’aise d’apprendre et d’utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle, des plateformes CRM et des outils numériques de vente.
  • Possède de bonnes aptitudes en recherche et est capable de comprendre rapidement une organisation et d’identifier les bonnes personnes à approcher.
  • Possède de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et peut contribuer à la création de documents professionnels destinés aux clients.
  • Est curieuse, à l’aise de poser des questions et d’interagir avec des professionnels de la santé et des dirigeants d’organisations.
  • Est capable de travailler de manière autonome selon des priorités clairement établies, tout en collaborant étroitement avec une petite équipe.
  • Une expérience avec HubSpot, la vente B2B, le secteur de la santé, la santé numérique, le marketing ou le développement des affaires constitue un atout, mais n’est pas requise.

Ce que vous développerez

Ce rôle vous permettra de participer à l’ensemble du processus de commercialisation d’un produit canadien de santé numérique, de la prospection à la conversion des clients. Vous développerez une expérience pratique en vente B2B, prospection assistée par l’IA, HubSpot et découverte client, tout en collaborant avec des leaders expérimentés. Vous contribuerez également à transformer les besoins et commentaires des clients en stratégies et outils de mise en marché.

------

ENGLISH

About Akinox

Akinox is a Canadian digital health company focused on improving how patients access care and how healthcare organizations deliver it. For more than 15 years, Akinox has worked with healthcare organizations and governments to design and operate digital health solutions at scale. Our work spans primary care, virtual care, patient access and clinical workflow transformation.

About CarePath

CarePath turns fragmented clinical information into a clear, actionable view of the patient.

Designed for primary care and community health teams, CarePath uses artificial intelligence to streamline patient record review, identify key clinical information, and support more efficient care preparation. The solution is designed to reduce the administrative and clinical workload associated with onboarding new patients. CarePath is now entering an important phase of commercialization and customer growth.

The Role

We are looking for an early-career Business Development & Sales Coordinator to support the growth of CarePath.

This is a 6 months contract position at 30 hours per week, with the possibility of extension. We are looking for someone with a strong interest in sales, business development, and technology in the healthcare sector. Working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and Sales Solutions Architect, you will help identify prospective customers, execute outreach, support discovery and sales activities, and ensure opportunities are effectively tracked and advanced.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct weekly AI-assisted lead generation and account research against defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs).
  • Research target healthcare organizations and identify relevant decision-makers and contacts.
  • Build and maintain prioritized prospect and outreach lists.
  • Conduct email, LinkedIn and phone outreach using established CarePath messaging and campaigns.
  • Identify and engage with warm leads, conduct initial qualification and coordinate hand-off to the Sales Solutions Architect for deeper discovery and solution discussions.
  • Accurately record outreach, customer interactions, meeting notes, lead status and next steps in HubSpot.
  • Assist with customer discovery, including account research, meeting preparation, note-taking and follow-up.
  • Help prepare and customize sales decks, one-pagers, case studies and other sales and marketing materials.
  • Interact with customers and users to help capture feedback, results, data points and insights that can be used in sales and marketing.
  • Support webinars, conferences, product launches and other go-to-market activities, including invitations and follow-up.
  • Provide a concise weekly update to the Chief Growth Officer covering activity, leads, meetings, pipeline movement and relevant market feedback.
  • Assist with other sales, business development and go-to-market activities as required.

What We're Looking For

This is an early-career role, so we don't expect you to arrive knowing everything about healthcare or enterprise sales. We are looking for someone who is:

  • Has at least a high school diploma and is currently pursuing post-secondary studies, has recently graduated, or is approximately within the first five years of their career.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally by email, phone and LinkedIn.
  • Organized and able to consistently follow through on outreach and next steps.
  • Comfortable learning and using AI tools, CRM platforms and digital sales tools.
  • A strong researcher who can quickly understand an organization and identify the right people to approach.
  • Able to write clearly and help create professional customer-facing materials.
  • Curious and comfortable asking questions and interacting with healthcare professionals and organizational leaders.
  • Able to work independently within clear priorities while collaborating closely with a small team.

Experience with HubSpot, B2B sales, healthcare, digital health, marketing or business development is an asset, but not required.

What You'll Gain

This role will allow you to participate in the entire commercialization process of a Canadian digital health product, from prospecting to customer conversion. You will gain hands-on experience in B2B sales, AI-assisted prospecting, HubSpot, and customer discovery while working alongside experienced leaders. You will also contribute to transforming customer needs and feedback into go-to-market strategies and sales tools.

Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Consultant to lead the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions supporting global procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, and supply chain initiatives. This role focuses on delivering scalable SAP S/4HANA MM solutions that streamline Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, vendor management, material planning, and inventory optimization across enterprise environments.
You will work closely with procurement teams, supply chain leaders, warehouse operations, finance stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and technical teams to design and configure SAP MM solutions that improve procurement efficiency, inventory visibility, and operational performance. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in SAP MM configuration, cross-functional integration, and SAP S/4HANA transformation projects while maintaining a strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay business processes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and design scalable SAP MM solutions supporting procurement and supply chain operations.
  • Configure SAP Materials Management components including Purchasing, Inventory Management, Material Master, Vendor Master, Valuation, and Invoice Verification.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Configure organizational structures including plants, storage locations, purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, valuation areas, and company codes.
  • Configure material types, material groups, account determination, release strategies, valuation classes, and movement types.
  • Design and configure procurement processes including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, RFQs, and source determination.
  • Configure inventory management processes including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, physical inventory, and cycle counting.
  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to prepare Functional Specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, workflows, BADIs, User Exits, IDOCs, and forms.
  • Integrate SAP MM with SD, PP, FI/CO, WM, EWM, QM, PM, and Ariba modules.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration projects, system upgrades, testing, cutover activities, and post-go-live support.
  • Develop functional documentation including Business Process Documents (BPDs), Functional Specifications, Configuration Documents, and Test Scripts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide ongoing application support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, solution design workshops, architecture reviews, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills
  • Seven or more years of hands-on SAP MM consulting experience supporting enterprise SAP implementations.
  • Strong expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Materials Management configuration.
  • Extensive knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Purchasing, Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Material Master, Vendor Master, and Procurement processes.
  • Strong experience configuring material types, purchasing document types, release procedures, movement types, valuation classes, account determination, and pricing procedures.
  • Experience configuring procurement processes including RFQs, Contracts, Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Orders, and Vendor Evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse operations, stock transfers, physical inventory, cycle counting, and inventory valuation.
  • Experience integrating SAP MM with FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, WM, EWM, PM, and Ariba.
  • Experience preparing Functional Specifications for ABAP developments including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
  • Familiarity with IDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs, EDI, and middleware integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting integrations with supplier portals, procurement platforms, warehouse management systems, and third-party logistics providers.
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, SAP GUI, and SAP Fiori.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and business process optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum or SAP Activate implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration projects.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori Apps, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM), and SAP Business Network.
  • Knowledge of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Warehouse Management (WM), and Transportation Management (TM).
  • Experience supporting global procurement and supply chain organizations.
  • Familiarity with Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Demand Planning, and Supply Chain Planning processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Coupa, Jaggaer, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Boomi, or other enterprise applications.
  • SAP Certified Application Associate or SAP Certified Professional certification in SAP MM or SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, retail, or consumer goods industries.
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), procurement reporting, and operational analytics is a plus.

Project Environment
You will be joining a global SAP transformation program responsible for modernizing procurement, inventory, and supply chain operations across multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • SAP S/4HANA Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects
  • Enterprise Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process transformation
  • Global procurement standardization and vendor management optimization
  • SAP Ariba and supplier collaboration platform integration
  • Warehouse Management (WM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) modernization
  • Inventory optimization and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) enhancements
  • SAP Fiori application rollout for procurement and warehouse users
  • Enterprise workflow automation for purchasing approvals
  • Cloud-based SAP integrations using SAP BTP and Integration Suite
This is a hands-on functional consulting role where you will contribute to solution architecture, SAP MM configuration, procurement process optimization, system integration, testing, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise supply chain platforms.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.
