raw.excerpt: Erasca is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing medicines for the benefit of patients with cancer.
raw.description:
Erasca is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing medicines for the benefit of patients with cancer. Our programs take novel approaches to shutting down one of cancer’s most commonly mutated signaling cascades, the RAS/MAPK pathway, which affects approximately 5.5 million lives each year worldwide. The name “Erasca” has an important embedded meaning: it is a contraction of our audacious hope to “erase cancer” that drives our mission and everything that we do on behalf of patients with cancer.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Chief Regulatory Affairs Officer, the Executive Director or VP, Regulatory Affairs will lead regulatory strategy for defined disease area and develop and execute global regulatory strategies and submissions from pre-IND through regulatory approval to launch, commercialization, and product lifecycle management.

Note that this position can be hybrid in San Diego, CA or South San Francisco, CA or fully remote anywhere in the United States.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Represent regulatory on program and study teams and in disease area strategy and planning meetings
  • Working with the team, develop regulatory strategies to ensure development plans are comprehensive and comply with regulatory requirements
  • Lead or support preparation and review of regulatory documents (e.g., IND, CTA/IMPD, DSUR, pre-meeting briefing document, iPSP/PIP, NDA, sNDA), including oversight of regulatory submissions to assure technical accuracy and completeness
  • Act as Regulatory Affairs representative in business development and due diligence activities
  • Review relevant clinical documents for scientific content and regulatory compliance
  • Act as primary liaison with the FDA and OUS health authorities to facilitate timely review and approval of regulatory submissions and lead regulatory milestone discussions (e.g., pre-IND, End-of-Phase, pre-NDA meetings, EU Scientific Advice)
  • Plan and direct regulatory activities through regulatory staff and cross functional teams
  • Provide regulatory support for company compliance initiatives
  • Regulatory support and guidance for regulatory audits and/or inspections
  • Regulatory oversight of service providers and regulatory consultants
  • Lead and support continued development of new systems and processes to improve efficiency for the regulatory department in a growing organization
  • Keep current on US and OUS regulations that apply to company products and processes
  • Perform all duties in keeping with the Company’s core values, policies and all applicable regulations

Required Education and Experience:

  • Undergraduate degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in pharma or biotech regulatory affairs required, including deep expertise in global regulatory strategy from pre-IND through NDA and post approval
  • Proven knowledge and experience in US and EU regulatory affairs required (e.g., IND, CTA, CTN, NDA) and leading formal interactions with health authorities (e.g., pre IND, End‑of‑Phase, Scientific Advice, etc)
  • Experience with NDA submission and product approval preferred
  • Experience with expedited programs for serious conditions such as FastTrack, Breakthrough Therapy Designation, PRIME, a plus
  • Proven knowledge of FDA and ICH guidelines
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical workable plans
  • Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
  • Effective interpersonal, communication and influencing skills, including excellent writing skills
  • Experience leading, mentoring, and developing direct reports
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve high-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment; a collaborative team player with a can-do attitude and the ability to identify and implement creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Strong learning orientation, curiosity, and commitment to science and patients

raw.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

raw.description:
UK | Full-time | Remote

Explorance is looking for a driven Account Executive to grow our presence in the UK higher education market.

This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys the hunt: identifying opportunities, opening new accounts, creating pipeline, engaging senior decision-makers, and turning complex conversations into closed business.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through solution positioning, negotiation, and close, while partnering with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and other teams to bring the right Explorance solutions to prospective customers.

If you're a proactive SaaS seller who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to you, enjoys building a territory, and is motivated by ambitious targets and winning new business, we'd like to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Build your territory: Develop and execute a focused territory strategy to identify and win new business across the UK higher education market.
  • Create pipeline: Proactively generate opportunities through outbound prospecting, cold outreach, networking, events, referrals, and targeted account development.
  • Open new accounts: Identify the right stakeholders, create entry points into target organizations, and build relationships with senior and C-level decision-makers.
  • Own the sales cycle: Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Sell strategically: Understand prospective customers' challenges and position Explorance's solutions around their priorities, needs, and desired outcomes.
  • Navigate complex deals: Build consensus across multiple stakeholders and confidently manage both shorter opportunities and longer, complex SaaS sales cycles.
  • Collaborate to win: Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and internal subject-matter experts throughout the sales process.
  • Represent Explorance: Build market presence through industry events, conferences, webinars, and other networking opportunities.
  • Know your market: Develop strong knowledge of Explorance's solutions, the higher education landscape, competitors, and emerging market needs.

What we're looking for

Above all, we're looking for a hunter, someone who is energized by creating opportunities and winning new customers.

You'll ideally bring:

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.
  • Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition and outbound business development.
  • Experience building pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound opportunities.
  • Strong prospecting skills and the confidence to engage senior and C-level decision-makers.
  • Experience managing the full SaaS sales cycle, from first contact through negotiation and close.
  • Strong territory and account planning skills.
  • A proactive, resilient, and results-driven approach to sales.
  • Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • The ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel across the UK and internationally when required.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into higher education or similarly complex organizations.
  • Experience with feedback, analytics, employee experience, or education technology solutions.
  • Experience selling SaaS solutions involving multiple stakeholders and longer sales cycles.

Why Explorance?

Explorance provides the opportunity to sell established SaaS solutions while continuing to expand our footprint in the UK higher education market. You'll have ownership of your territory and the opportunity to build relationships with leading institutions, create new business from the ground up, and work alongside experienced teams across Sales, Marketing, and Sales Engineering.

Location & Travel

This position is UK-based, and candidates must currently reside in the UK. The role requires regular travel to meet prospective customers and attend industry events.

About Explorance

Explorance empowers organizations with next-generation feedback analytics to accelerate the insight-to-action cycle, embracing our philosophy of “Feedback for the brave” to drive purpose, impact, and growth.

With more than 20 years of experience, Explorance works with organizations around the world through solutions including Blue, BlueX, Metrics That Matter, and MLY.

Inclusion at Explorance

At Explorance, we put people first and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Employment is contingent upon satisfactory background and reference checks.

US LBM is one of the leading and fastest growing distributors of specialty building materials in the United States, with a team of over 13,000 employees located throughout the country. Since our founding in 2009, we have acquired over 100 companies and have expanded to more than 450 locations serving 37 states. US LBM is a progressive organization that promotes a unique culture that focuses on the value of its customers and associates. Developing our people is critical to our strategy and fostering our culture of empowerment.

.

A Brief Overview

The US LBM Domain Architect plays a critical role in translating enterprise architecture strategy into practical, scalable technology solutions within a defined business domain (e.g., Customer, Commerce, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Data, or Integration). This person is responsible for defining and governing domain-level architecture, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, and partnering closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to drive successful solution delivery. This role bridges enterprise architecture vision and delivery execution, ensuring that solutions across the domain are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with long-term strategy.

What you will do

  • Domain Architecture Leadership - Own the architecture strategy and roadmap for a defined domain. Translate enterprise architecture principles into domain patterns. Define applications, services, data flows, and integrations.
  • Solution Design & Governance - Lead architecture reviews and design sessions. Ensure alignment with standards, security, and scalability. Govern architectural consistency across the domain.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration - Partner with engineering, product, platform, and data teams. Act as bridge between enterprise architecture and delivery.
  • Architecture Standards & Patterns - Develop reference architectures and reusable patterns. Promote platform-first and event-driven approaches.
  • Technology Evaluation - Evaluate new technologies and platforms. Support build vs buy decisions and vendor selection.
  • Domain Roadmap Alignment - Maintain multi-year roadmap aligned to enterprise strategy.

Required For All Jobs

  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Comply with all policies and standards.
  • Adhere to Company’s commitment to workplace safety.
  • Participate in and complete assigned trainings.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience preferred.

Experience Qualifications

  • 5+ years in software engineering or architecture
  • Experience with microservices, APIs, event-driven systems
  • Extensive understanding in using AI first development and research
  • Strong understanding of application, data, and cloud architecture

Skills and Abilities

  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Containers and Kubernetes
  • API platforms and messaging systems (Kafka, event streaming)
  • Modern data architectures
  • Security and identity frameworks
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business value
  • Influence without authority
  • Strategic and execution-oriented mindset
  • Mentorship capability

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As the Renewals Account Manager for LATAM, you will manage an assigned territory, focusing on quoting, forecasting, and booking renewal contracts. Your primary goal is to drive the growth and retention of our customer base by reducing churn, improving on-time renewal rates, and identifying opportunities for expansion. You will serve as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring customer needs are addressed and long-term value is maximized through our solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end renewal cycle, from quoting and forecasting through negotiation and closure.
  • Drive customer retention, reduce churn, and improve on-time renewal performance.
  • Identify upsell, cross-sell, consolidation, and multi-year opportunities to expand customer relationships.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline data in Salesforce (SFDC) and other required tools.
  • Partner with Sales, Channel Partners, Distributors, and customers to develop renewal strategies and drive opportunities to closure.
  • Proactively identify renewal risks and customer needs, developing action plans to address them.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders while clearly communicating the company’s value proposition and renewal opportunities.

Qualifications


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of successful experience in a quota-carrying role, preferably in Sales, Subscription Renewals, or Account Management.
  • A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and maintaining an accurate forecast.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) for forecasting and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) tools.
  • Exceptional time management, organization, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting customers in the LATAM region.
  • Demonstrated ability to build complex quotes involving non-standard product configurations.
  • In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity products and the competitive landscape.

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

raw.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit .

Job Summary

    The Principal Solution Consultant is a senior solution consulting and methodology leader responsible for shaping complex, outcome-driven consulting engagements. This role leads complex consulting framing, executive-level discovery, outcome architecture, governance design, and practice quality for engagements that require a higher level of ambiguity management, stakeholder alignment, and advisory rigor.

    The Principal Solution Consultant sits above the Senior Solution Consultant role and focuses on complex or multi-domain engagements, methodology quality, and coaching across the practice. The role owns the consulting narrative and advisory quality for complex engagements, while Engagement Directors own broader executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, strategic escalation, and account-level value realization. Technical architecture, integration patterns, scalability, and detailed platform design remain owned by Technical Architects.

Job Responsibilities and Scope

    Responsibilities

    Complex Consulting Framing and Executive Discovery

  • Lead complex solution consulting engagements where business intent, operating model, value case, governance, and delivery approach need to be clarified before or during delivery.
  • Provide executive-level discovery and advisory leadership without owning account commercials, pricing, close plans, or portfolio strategy.
  • Shape business and operating-model architecture at the solution consulting level without owning detailed technical architecture, integrations, data flows, or platform standards.
  • Raise the quality of solution consulting work through methodology stewardship, stage-gate discipline, artifact quality, and coaching.
  • Lead executive-level discovery to clarify business intent, transformation constraints, value targets, operating model impacts, risks, and success measures.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured consulting narratives, decision paths, phased approaches, and measurable outcome models.
  • Frame current-state and future-state narratives that connect people, process, technology, governance, adoption, and value realization.
  • Guide senior stakeholders toward decision-ready recommendations while keeping the engagement grounded in feasible delivery and customer maturity.

    • Outcome Architecture and Governance Design

  • Define outcome architecture for complex engagements, including value hypotheses, KPI models, baseline measures, target outcomes, and benefits tracking approach.
  • Design governance models appropriate to engagement complexity, including stage gates, decision forums, escalation paths, and executive readout cadence.
  • Establish consulting guardrails for scope boundaries, assumptions, risk posture, adoption needs, success measures, and decision ownership.
  • Ensure that each major phase has clear evidence, decision points, and artifacts to support alignment and accountability.

    • ESM/ITSM Advisory Focus

  • Advise enterprise customers on the practical application of ITIL practices across the service value system, including service desk, incident, request, problem, change enablement, service level, knowledge, request configuration, asset, alerting and continual improvement practices.
  • Design operating models that connect IT service management teams with product, engineering, DevOps, and application development teams.
  • Provide high-level guidance around platform governance and security/compliance constraints.
  • Shape executive reporting and service performance management through outcome-oriented dashboards that support decisions rather than activity reporting.
  • Advise on CMDB and configuration management strategy, including the scope and purpose of the configuration model, CI classes and relationships, data ownership, discovery and reconciliation, service mapping, data quality controls, and the level of accuracy required for incident, change, problem, risk, and impact analysis.
  • Facilitate maturity assessments and prioritized roadmaps that sequence process, people, data, technology, governance, and adoption changes according to customer readiness, value, risk, and the ability to sustain the operating model after implementation.
  • Identify and recommend alternative/additional tooling whenever gaps in functionality have been recorded.
  • Assess where standardization/out-of-the-box platform capabilities can be leveraged to improve the user experience, improve scalability, and reduce technical debt/overhead
  • Identify and relate recommendations for custom solutions or alternative/additional tooling to justification via regulatory, operational, or business requirements

    • Methodology and Stage-Gate Advisory

  • Apply and evolve the Solution Consulting methodology while tailoring it to client context without losing rigor or consistency.
  • Guide teams through stage-gate advisory practices across diagnosis, design and planning, validation, activation, and scale.
  • Review key engagement artifacts for clarity, completeness, value alignment, and readiness for customer or executive review.
  • Identify gaps in advisory quality, governance, requirements clarity, adoption planning, or outcome measurement and help teams resolve them early.

    • Complex Deal Advisory and Scoping Support

  • Support complex pursuits by advising on discovery approach, advisory workshops, solution framing, scope assumptions, value case, and delivery risk.
  • Provide consulting input to proposals and SOWs where business outcomes, governance, operating model, phased roadmap, or methodology approach need stronger definition.
  • Partner with Sales and Account teams as an advisory and scoping contributor without owning pursuit strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, negotiation, or close plan.
  • Help identify whether an opportunity requires additional input from Engagement Directors, Principal Solution Architects, Technical Architects, or delivery leadership.

    • Artifact Ownership and Advisory Quality

  • Create or review high-value consulting artifacts such as value cases, current-state and future-state narratives, operating models, phased roadmaps, governance models, KPI models, benefits trackers, decision logs, and executive readouts.
  • Ensure artifacts are decision-ready, logically connected, customer-specific, and usable by delivery teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Convert field lessons into reusable playbooks, templates, accelerators, discovery guides, workshop formats, and quality standards.
  • Maintain a high bar for clarity, evidence, traceability, and measurable value across complex consulting engagements.

    • Coaching, Practice Quality, and Team Leadership

  • Coach Senior Solution Consultants and Solution Consultants through structured feedback, advisory review, workshop preparation, and artifact improvement.
  • Lead by example on executive communication, consulting structure, facilitation, value framing, and clarity through artifacts.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, enablement, communities of practice, and internal quality reviews for the Solution Consulting practice.
  • Contribute to team leadership activities where needed, including mentoring, capability planning, practice standards, and development of consulting talent.
  • Model responsible use of approved AI tools to improve delivery efficiency, speed, quality, consistency, and value realization across consulting workflows and reusable assets.

    • Decision Rights and Collaboration

  • The Principal Solution Consultant owns complex consulting framing, outcome architecture, methodology quality, stage-gate advisory, and coaching.
  • Senior Solution Consultants own solution design intent and customer-facing advisory on standard and medium-complexity engagements.
  • Principal Solution Architects and Technical Architects own technical architecture, integration patterns, scalability, platform design, and detailed technical feasibility.
  • Engagement Directors own executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, strategic escalation, and account-level value realization.
  • Sales owns account strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, negotiation, close plan, and deal progression.

    • Skills and Experience

    Required Qualifications

  • Proven ownership of large or complex consulting engagements with multiple stakeholders, workstreams, phases, or business domains.
  • Experience designing enterprise work management solutions using Atlassian products including Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Operations, Assets, and Confluence.
  • Demonstrated experience leading executive-level discovery, advisory workshops, governance forums, and decision-oriented client conversations.
  • Strong capability in problem framing, value modeling, KPI definition, roadmapping, operating model design, adoption planning, and benefits tracking.
  • Fluency in stage-gate governance, iterative delivery, consulting methodology, and outcome-based advisory practices.
  • Strong familiarity with enterprise delivery, ITSM, Agile, Work Management, service management, and adjacent Atlassian ecosystem considerations.
  • Ability to coach consultants, review advisory artifacts, and raise delivery quality through repeatable methods and reusable assets.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL concepts and practices; ITIL certification (Foundation or higher) preferred.
  • Ability to translate ITIL guidance into pragmatic processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Strong technical writing ability
  • Ability to speak clearly and concisely to audiences of varying technical aptitudes

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in regulated, complex, or enterprise environments such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, public sector, or global organizations.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, SAFe, Lean-Agile, DevOps, Enterprise Service Management, change management, or operating model frameworks.
  • Experience contributing to practice development, team leadership, hiring, onboarding, enablement, or consulting quality programs.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more of: ServiceNow, Zendesk, and/or BMC, including configuration and/or implementation delivery.
  • Experience working with integrations and enterprise reporting/analytics.
  • Experience leading enterprise-scale platform transformations, including migrations from legacy platforms to new solutions, with a focus on change impact across end users, external customers, operational teams, and executive stakeholders.

    • Key Competencies

  • Executive communication: concise, credible, decision-oriented communication with senior stakeholders.
  • Outcome architecture: links business goals, solution recommendations, adoption needs, and measurable value.
  • Structured problem-solving: turns ambiguity into a coherent plan, artifact set, and decision path.
  • Governance leadership: defines cadence, stage gates, decision forums, escalation paths, and evidence needs.
  • Systems thinking: connects people, process, technology, governance, risk, and operating model considerations.
  • Talent multiplier: raises the bar through coaching, quality review, reusable assets, and team leadership.

    • Career Path and Growth Options

    This role is part of the Solution Consulting Practice and provides multiple growth paths depending on strengths, business need, and leadership interests. Potential paths include:

  • Engagement Director, owning broader executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, and account-level value realization.
  • Practice Lead or Team Leadership, owning consulting capability development, standards, enablement, and people leadership.
  • Head of Solutions Consulting or similar senior leadership role, owning practice strategy, quality, and cross-functional alignment.

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Valiantys provides a barrier-free workplace and embraces all qualified applicants with varied perspectives and backgrounds.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. The Solutions Architect will serve as the technical lead in delivering the technical solution for new implementations or enhancements to existing customer implementations. The lead will be responsible for application and integration design, managing internal & external customer requirements, and test execution by working with a cross-functional team focused on system and operational readiness for go-live. The successful candidate will deliver technology solutions that meet or exceed design requirements as outlined by solution engineers. The Solutions Architect will also manage our Retail Compliance label program, building and certifying Compliance labels for customer implementations. Candidates must possess ZPL proficiency and strong attention to detail.


Essential Functions

raw.description:
Location:Remote

Job Type:Full-time

About Us!

At Ready Computing, we specialize in data-centric IT solutions that help organizations across healthcare, supply chain, finance, and manufacturing optimize their technology and data strategies. With offices in the U.S. and the UK, we provide expert consulting, development, and managed services to clients worldwide. We're committed to hiring top talent to drive innovation, particularly in the healthcare IT space.

The Software Architect designs Wellbase, Ready Computing’s managed services suite for healthcare and social-care organizations, and remains hands-on through implementation. Wellbase provides hosting, monitoring, analytics, and security to keep mission-critical systems available, secure, and improving. This player-coach role involves designing and owning end-to-end solutions while leading a small delivery team.

The work includes Wellbase’s agentic AI companion (Lucas), governed and auditable Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, policy and governance services, and product demonstration and staging environments. The role calls for curiosity about emerging technologies, confidence presenting architecture and tradeoffs to executives, and a strong sense of ownership.

What you'll do

Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Define technical requirements and target architecture for new platform capabilities, and stay accountable through design, implementation, and release.
  • Design and lead delivery of agentic AI solutions, including tool-using agents, evaluation approaches, and safe integration with healthcare workflows.
  • Architect and extend MCP-based services that connect agents and applications to enterprise systems, data, and licensed capabilities.
  • Own architecture for policy and governance services that control access, content decisions, and regulated use of data and AI.
  • Shape the architecture of demo and staging environments so new capabilities can be shown reliably to customers and executives.
  • Lead a small team as a player-coach: set technical direction, review design and code, and implement the hardest pieces yourself.
  • Present architecture, options, and recommendations to executive stakeholders; take ownership of decisions and outcomes.
  • Apply CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes deployment practices to keep the platform releasable and operable.
  • Mentor developers and raise the quality bar for design, security, and delivery.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation that others can build from.
  • Design and optimize data stores (relational and, where needed, vector or other specialized stores) to support agents, applications, and governance.
  • Implement authorization, policy, and security controls appropriate to healthcare and other regulated data.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

What you bring

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in software architecture and design patterns for cloud-native and service-based enterprise systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java, with the ability to work across a polyglot stack.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Google Cloud preferred), containers, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience designing REST APIs and distributed services; familiarity with workflow or orchestration systems is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and development tools such as Git, Jenkins, and JIRA.
  • Database design and optimization, primarily relational (PostgreSQL); exposure to vector or search stores is a plus.
  • Familiarity with enterprise frameworks such as Spring or FastAPI.
  • Working knowledge of policy-as-code, authorization frameworks, or similar governance controls is a plus.
  • Some hands-on experience with agentic AI development (LLM-based agents, tool use or MCP, evaluation design, or similar).
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry (OTel).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and a track record of evaluating and adopting new technologies where they create real leverage.

Qualaifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise-level architectures, including hands-on design and implementation. Some experience building or leading agentic AI solutions is required.
  • Comfort working with healthcare or other regulated data environments.
  • Deep healthcare-interoperability experience is helpful but not required.

Core Competencies

  • Technical Architectural Leadership: Architects scalable, future-ready solutions and leads a small team through implementation, remaining hands-on on the hardest work.
  • Solution Ownership: Takes end-to-end accountability for designs and outcomes, from first concept through delivery and operation.
  • Curiosity and Innovation: Actively explores new technologies and approaches, especially in agentic AI and platform engineering, and applies them with sound judgment.
  • Executive Communication: Presents architecture, options, and recommendations clearly to executive audiences, and translates complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Diagnoses and resolves intricate technical challenges in order to keep programs moving.
  • Attention to Detail & Security: Maintains rigorous standards in design and development to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of enterprise solutions.

Physical & Mental Qualifications:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

  • All positions require the ability to work on a computer for extended periods of time, including typing, using a mouse, and viewing a monitor throughout an eight (8) hour workday. Employees must be able to sit and/or stand for prolonged periods, as needed to perform their duties.
  • Positions may involve infrequent lifting of items such as a laptop or related equipment. Walking requirements are limited to normal travel or commute needs as outlined in this section.
  • All roles require the ability to communicate effectively, including speaking on the phone and collaborating with team members, clients, vendors, and other business partners. Employees must be able to focus on multiple tasks and project requirements throughout the workday. Most positions may require occasional travel.

Home Office Requirements

  • A minimum internet speed of 25 Mbps for downloads and 1.5 Mbps for uploads is required.
  • A private Wi-Fi network with a strong, unique password is necessary to access company data or systems.
  • The company provides a monthly internet stipend. New hires must complete a speed test during onboarding and update any default router passwords to ensure secure network access.

Why Join Us?

Innovative & Impactful Work – Your contributions will shape healthcare technology and improve patient outcomes.

Global Reach & Growth Opportunities – Work with leading experts in healthcare IT and enterprise solutions.

Collaborative & Dynamic Culture – Join a supportive team environment that values knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career development.

Competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Four health plan options to fit your needs.
  • 401(k) matching to help secure your financial future.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for work-life balance.
  • Wellness programs to support your mental and physical well-being.
  • Financial planning services to help you manage your future.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re excited about healthcare IT, system integration, and building next-gen interoperability solutions, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or contact for more information.

Ready Computing is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Affirmative Action (AA) employer. We are committed to EEO for all protected classes, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by any law.

Salary: $125,000 - $145,000

raw.description:
Redica Systems is looking for a Manager, Regulatory Intelligence to lead a team responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and structuring regulatory developments across 150+ countries.

In this role, you will oversee the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of regulatory intelligence covering Pharmaceutical, Biologics, MedTech, and Animal Health sectors. You'll guide the team in interpreting regulatory developments, determining industry relevance and impact, and maintaining reliable information within Redica's regulatory intelligence platform.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who brings strong GxP knowledge, sound judgment, and a practical approach to managing people, improving processes, and making effective use of technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Solutions Coordinators, providing clear priorities, guidance, feedback, and performance management.
  • Oversee global regulatory monitoring activities, ensuring relevant developments are identified, evaluated, and processed accurately and on time.
  • Guide the team's assessment of regulatory developments, including industry scope, GxP applicability, operational impact, and classification decisions.
  • Maintain standards for structured regulatory data, including metadata accuracy, effective dates, consultation deadlines, enforcement timelines, and document relationships.
  • Establish and monitor team KPIs covering productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround times, addressing gaps and improving performance.

raw.description:
Are you a Swahili language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Swahili speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Swahili language specialists who live and breathe the intricacies of Swahili grammar, syntax, morphology, semantics, phonetics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like noun classes, verb conjugation, sentence structure, idiomatic expressions, tone and pronunciation, and cultural nuances—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in Swahili language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, translation experience, or hands-on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Swahili language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Workplace type: Remote

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior Level

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

raw.description:
Job Description:

Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships


Third Derivative Overview

Third Derivative (D3), a program of RMI, accelerates climate innovation by bringing together startups, investors, corporations, and technical and market experts to help promising climate technologies reach commercial scale.

Through our global accelerator and broader ecosystem, D3 works with hundreds of climate technology companies across major emissions sectors and a network of leading venture investors, corporations, and other capital providers.

Access to the right type of capital at the right stage is one of the most important challenges facing climate technology companies. D3 is building a comprehensive approach to helping startups navigate that challenge—supporting companies in developing effective capital strategies, connecting them with relevant investors and funding partners, and developing new capital solutions where gaps exist.

We are seeking a Senior Associate to help drive this work.


Position Overview

The Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships will help D3 startups access the capital they need to grow and scale.

Working across D3's portfolio, the Senior Associate will identify companies' financing needs and help develop and deliver the right solutions. This may mean working directly with founders to develop their fundraising strategy and connecting them with relevant investors and capital providers; or, where existing sources of capital do not adequately meet portfolio needs, helping D3 design and launch new financing solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles.

The role sits at the intersection of startup finance, investor engagement, and capital innovation. The Senior Associate will develop a strong understanding of both startup financing needs and capital-provider mandates and use those insights to connect the two—and to identify where new solutions are needed.


Key Responsibilities

Deliver capital solutions to D3 startups

  • Work directly with D3 startups to understand their financing needs, readiness, and potential capital pathways.
  • Advise founders on fundraising strategy, including the appropriate type and timing of capital, investor targeting, financing trade-offs, and preparation for investor conversations.
  • Connect startups with relevant investors and capital providers across venture equity, strategic capital, debt, project finance, non-dilutive and catalytic capital, and other financing pathways.
  • Help companies understand investor requirements and what needs to be true to successfully access different forms of capital.
  • Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring challenges and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.

Build and activate the capital ecosystem

  • Develop and deepen relationships with investors and capital providers relevant to D3 startups.
  • Build a strong understanding of investor mandates, investment criteria, and emerging areas of interest to enable targeted, high-quality introductions.
  • Create opportunities for meaningful engagement between D3 startups and capital partners, including curated introductions, investor sessions, and other targeted programming.
  • Use insights from investors and startups to identify gaps between the capital available in the market and the financing needs of climate technology companies.

Support D3’s investment and capital solutions strategy

  • Support the deployment and management of D3’s existing investment vehicles and contribute an investor perspective to startup selection and portfolio strategy.
  • Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring capital gaps and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.
  • Where relevant, research and evaluate potential new capital solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles that respond to portfolio needs.
  • Support the design, fundraising, structuring, and implementation of new capital initiatives as opportunities emerge.
  • Turn company- and portfolio-level experience into insights, tools, and recommendations that strengthen D3’s broader approach to supporting startups’ capital needs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience in venture capital, impact investing, investment banking, private credit, project finance, startup finance, entrepreneurial support, or related field.
  • Solid understanding of how early- and growth-stage companies raise and structure capital and how investors evaluate opportunities.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, with comfort interpreting company financials, capitalization structures, investment terms, and financing scenarios.
  • Experience working directly with startups, investors, or other capital providers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex financial concepts for different audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams independently and operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across entrepreneurs, investors, technical experts, and internal teams.
  • A systems-oriented mindset: ability to identify patterns across individual situations and translate them into repeatable tools, processes, or solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience investing in or supporting climate technology companies.
  • Experience across multiple forms of capital beyond traditional venture equity, such as venture debt, project finance, asset-backed finance, non-dilutive capital, or blended/catalytic finance.
  • Experience designing or launching investment vehicles, financing products, or capital programs.
  • Experience working with technically complex or capital-intensive companies.
  • Familiarity with climate technology markets and the financing challenges associated with scaling new technologies.
  • Existing relationships across the climate investment and financing ecosystem.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You may be a particularly strong fit if you:

  • Enjoy moving between company-level problem solving and portfolio-level strategy.
  • Can sit with a founder and work through a financing challenge, then step back and ask what that challenge tells us about a broader market or capital gap.
  • Understand investor incentives and can translate them clearly and constructively for entrepreneurs.
  • Are comfortable working across different forms of capital rather than assuming venture equity is always the answer.
  • Like building things—new tools, processes, partnerships, and potentially investment products—rather than simply operating established programs.
  • Combine analytical rigor with strong judgment and relationship skills.
  • Are motivated by helping promising climate technologies navigate the path from innovation to commercial scale.

Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. This role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States and will require travel, at least once a month.


We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.


We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs).


Compensation   

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range of this position is $84,170-$103,739. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role’s scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 5% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

  

Benefits:    

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting
  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability
  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans
  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts
  • Fertility and hormonal health support
  • Mental health and wellness support
  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)
  • Generous paid time off and sick leave
  • Paid sabbatical leave
  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography
  • Work from home and home technology allowances
  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)
  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases
  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)
  • Hybrid / remote work options
  • Team retreats and geographic meetups
  • Rewards and recognition programs

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Medicaid Enterprise System (MES) Manager leads and supports delivery of complex MES-related consulting services for HHS agencies.

Overview

The Medicaid Enterprise System (MES) Manager leads and supports delivery of complex MES-related consulting services for HHS agencies. This role primarily supports our U.S. Territory-based clients, combines client leadership, delivery execution, and subject matter expertise to support MES and service-related modernization initiatives. The MES Manager operates across engagements in both lead and supporting roles, driving delivery outcomes while navigating complex stakeholder environments that include government agencies, system integrators, and federal partners.

The primary area of focus for the MES Manager role is support of MES initiatives in Puerto Rico, including system modernization efforts, vendor oversight, and program-level advisory. This role will play a key project, program, and at time portfolio manager level role, and in doing so will help ensure delivery quality, stakeholder alignment, and execution consistency across MES initiatives. The role requires the ability to translate policy, operational, and technical requirements into actionable execution, manage delivery risk in high-visibility environments, and provide clear, credible guidance to SMA and federal-partner clients. The successful candidate will bring deep MES domain expertise, strong program and project management leadership, experience operating within a consulting services delivery model, and prior experience interfacing with both federal partners and SMAs. Successful candidates must also possess the ability to adapt best practices to the operational realities, scale, and capacity of a U.S. territory Medicaid agency.

This position offers flexibility in work location, with the resource able to sit remotely or in one of BerryDunn’s offices, depending on preference. Regardless of location, the role requires regular collaboration with distributed teams and travel to client sites, generally expected to range from 25–50%, depending on engagement phase and client needs.

You Will

  • Lead and support delivery of Medicaid Enterprise System initiatives for State Medicaid Agencies (SMAs) and other Health and Human Services (HHS) agencies, including system modernization, implementation oversight and program advisory
  • Serve as a key client interface, providing guidance to agency stakeholders and supporting informed decision-making
  • Manage and coordinate across complex, multi-stakeholder environments, including vendors, system integrators, and government entities at territory, state, and federal levels
  • Support vendor oversight, performance monitoring, and implementation activities to help ensure alignment with program objectives
  • Identify, manage, and communicate project status, risks, and issues driving timely resolution and maintaining stakeholder alignment
  • Lead and support the development and maturation of program and project governance structures, including PMO- or PgMO-aligned frameworks
  • Lead and contribute to strategic planning, funding and acquisition, program and project management, and vendor management services
  • Lead and contribute to the development of key MES deliverables such as Concepts of Operations (ConOps), Advance Planning Documents (APDs), MES Roadmaps, MITA State Self-Assessments (SS-As), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and engagement and federal reporting artifacts
  • Provide subject matter expertise in Medicaid domains such as eligibility and enrollment, claims, financial management, and provider management, advising on impacts of federal regulations, State Plan Amendments (SPAs), waivers, policy changes, operations, and process improvements
  • Provide system and implementation expertise including knowledge of Medicaid and HHS vendor marketplace, procurement processes, and system implementation life cycles
  • Support system integration and interoperability efforts, including coordination with federal data hubs and integration across MES modulars and related human services programs (e.g. SNAP, TANF)
  • Lead, develop, and manage staff in support of their professional development journeys and engagement responsibilities
  • Contribute to business development efforts and practice growth initiatives

You Have

  • 10-15+ years of experience in Medicaid, Health and Human Services (HHS), or public sector consulting
  • Significant experience supporting Medicaid Enterprise Systems (MES) initiatives, including large-scale modular system implementations
  • Demonstrated experience delivering within a consulting services environment, including strategic planning, funding and acquisition, program and project management, and vendor management services
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments, including government agencies, vendors, system integrators, and federal partners
  • Experience managing or overseeing vendor performance, accountability for delivery outcomes
  • Experience engaging with and advising executive-level stakeholders at the HHS and Medicaid territory, state, and/or federal levels, including the ability to influence decisions and communicate effectively
  • Experience working within structured project, program, or portfolio governance frameworks (e.g. PMO or PgMO)
  • Demonstrated experience leading project teams including mentoring, coaching, and performance management
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team environment
  • Strong knowledge of and experience with Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS), Eligibility and Enrollment (E&E) Systems, and/or other modular Medicaid and HHS agency-level IT solutions
  • Proven ability to adapt to shifting priorities and evolving client needs in a fast-paced environment
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and vendor partners
  • Strong active listening skills, with the ability to understand client and team needs, respond with empathy, and incorporate feedback constructively
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, often with limited notice, while maintaining high-quality standards and meeting critical deadlines

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $150,000-$180,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

About the Role:

The Privacy Counsel II will be a key member of the GoodRx legal team focused on privacy issues and will be an integral part of the team. You will exercise independent judgment on complex privacy matters and help develop Privacy Program objectives. You will be expected to stay up-to-date on relevant laws and regulations in the data privacy space, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.   • Lead in reviewing marketing initiatives to ensure compliance with data protection laws
  • Lead Privacy Program initiatives and risk management workstreams from start to finish, with accountability for results that may impact the entire function

  • Experience working cross-functionally on compliance matters, including coordinating across teams and influencing diverse stakeholders

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!
