Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Interested in benefits?

raw.title: Head of Global Services
raw.excerpt: We are hiring a Head of Global Services to lead and scale a unified services organization covering three functions: technical support, professional services, and presales engineering.
raw.description:
We are hiring a Head of Global Services to lead and scale a unified services organization covering three functions: technical support, professional services, and presales engineering. You will lead through existing team managers for support operations and presales, while designing and building the structures, tooling, and hiring needed for the next order of magnitude. These functions share one technical talent pool and one career progression path; this role owns that pool end to end, from L1 support engineer to the senior engineers who deliver billable services and support the sales team.

You work on the system, not in it. Your managers run the day-to-day operation; your job is capacity allocation across the three demand streams, the operating model, the economics, and the growth of the team.

The anchor competency for this role is support scaling. We are looking for someone who has already scaled a technical support organization at a technology company to serve thousands of customers and knows the predictable failure points: tooling that collapses under volume, tier-1 burnout, knowledge trapped in senior engineers' heads, SLA models that don't survive 10x growth, hiring pipelines that can't keep pace. The right candidate solves these problems before they appear, not after.

Around that anchor, this role owns the economics and delivery of professional services and the effectiveness of technical presales, balancing one team's capacity across contractual support obligations, billable engagements, and revenue-generating presales work.

Responsibilities

1. Support at scale

  • Design and execute a support operating model that scales to thousands of customers without degrading response quality or growing cost linearly with customer count
  • Build a tiered support model with clear ownership boundaries, escalation paths, and handoff criteria between tiers
  • Drive ticket deflection: knowledge base, technical content, documentation feedback loops into engineering, self-service, and community channels
  • Deploy and own support tooling, including automation and AI-assisted resolution for tier-1 volume
  • Own SLA design and delivery for customers.

2. Professional services and presales

  • Own professional services delivery: scoping, staffing, and delivery quality
  • Own presales engineering effectiveness in partnership with sales leadership: POC support, demos, technical validation, and RFP responses
  • Define and enforce resource allocation rules across support, billable services, and presales demand competing for the same engineers
  • Develop services packaging and pricing in partnership with the CRO

3. Organization and talent

  • Own the unified career ladder from L1 support through certification milestones to L3, professional services, and presales participation
  • Build the hiring plan and coverage model for follow-the-sun operations across regions
  • Define the metrics that matter across all three functions: resolution times, deflection rate, CSAT, SLA compliance, PS utilization and margin, presales win contribution
  • Turn support and services data into product signal: recurring issues feed engineering priorities, not just ticket queues
  • Work directly with sales, customer success, and engineering leadership on escalated accounts, renewals at risk, and services-driven expansion

Mandatory requirements

We will not consider candidates without these.

  • You have scaled a technical support organization at a technology company from hundreds to thousands of customers, and you can walk us through exactly what you changed, what broke, and what you would do differently
  • You have managed managers, not just individual contributors, and built team structure across time zones
  • You have owned services economics: headcount planning, cost per ticket, utilization, and the deflection and automation work that keeps support costs sub-linear to customer growth
  • You have implemented or replaced support tooling at scale (ticketing, knowledge management, customer portals) and lived with the consequences
  • You have managed a shared technical talent pool serving both contractual obligations and billable or revenue-generating work, and you can explain how you resolved the contention
  • Deep familiarity with B2B technical services for infrastructure or networking products, where customers are engineers and wrong answers cause outages

Strong pluses

  • Experience leading professional services or presales engineering as formal functions, including packaging, pricing, and margin ownership
  • Experience supporting open-source software commercially, where the line between community and paying customer matters
  • Networking domain knowledge (routing, VPN, firewalling) or experience with a network OS vendor or adjacent infrastructure product
  • Experience building certification-linked career progression for technical teams
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI agents or automation for tier-1 ticket resolution

What we are not looking for

  • Someone whose scaling experience is theoretical, secondhand, or limited to consumer support
  • A generalist services executive who has administered these functions but never personally driven a support scaling transition
  • A pure people manager who delegates all technical and tooling decisions
  • Someone who needs the playbook handed to them. You bring the playbook.

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is the company behind VyOS, the enterprise-grade open source networking platform for bare metal, cloud, and edge. VyOS powers mission-critical connectivity for enterprises, service providers, and governments worldwide, and is available across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and other cloud platforms. Our mission is to return full control and ownership of network infrastructure to our users.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

By clicking 'Submit Application,' you consent to VyOS Networks processing your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

For more information about how we process your personal data, including the legal bases for processing, retention periods, and your rights, please see our Privacy Policy.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleWillow Health delivers virtual-first crisis stabilization and bridge care where appropriate to people who wouldotherwise land in an emergency department or an inpatient bed.
raw.description:
About the Role

    Willow Health delivers virtual-first crisis stabilization and bridge care where appropriate to people who wouldotherwise land in an emergency department or an inpatient bed. We serve currently patients over 18 with behavioral health conditions.
    The Medical Director is Willow's senior practicing psychiatrist and the physician accountable for the quality and safety of care delivered every day. This is a working clinical leadership role: you will carry your own panel, serve as the supervising or collaborating physician for our nurse practitioners, and own the day-to-day clinical operations of the programs — escalations, coverage, case review, and the judgment calls that determine whether a patient stabilizes at home or needs a higher level of care.
    You will report to the Chief Medical Officer and partner closely with our clinical supervisors, clinical operations,compliance, and product. This role is designed for a psychiatrist who wants to collaborate in building andimproving a care model rather than inherit one.
  • Reports to: Chief Medical Officer
  • Direct reports: Nurse practitioners; physician colleagues as the medical staff grows
  • Location: Remote (New York and North Carolina markets)
  • Status: Full-time, exempt
  • Time allocation: Approximately 50% direct patient care, 50% clinical leadership and oversight
  • Working hours for the clinic are Monday - Friday from 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time.

Key Responsibilities

    Direct patient care

  • Carry a clinical panel across crisis stabilization and bridge services, including initial psychiatric evaluations, medication management, and crisis psychotherapy encounters.
  • Serve as the physician of record for high-acuity and diagnostically complex patients, including those with co-occurring substance use disorders.
  • Provide same-day and urgent assessments when risk escalates, and make the level-of-care determination when a patient needs transfer to a higher level of care.
  • Document to clinical and billing standard, including structured risk assessment and the elements required for crisis psychotherapy coding.

    • Supervision of nurse practitioners

  • Serve as supervising or collaborating physician for Willow's psychiatric nurse practitioners in accordance with New York and North Carolina requirements, including written collaborative or supervisory agreements, required chart review, and documented quality improvement meetings.
  • Provide real-time clinical backup: be reachable for consultation on risk, medication, and disposition questions during clinical hours.
  • Run recurring individual/group supervision and group case conference; set expectations for prescribing practice, risk assessment, and documentation.
  • Complete competency assessment, onboarding sign-off, and performance input for each NP in partnership with the CMO.

    • Daily clinical operations

  • Own day-to-day clinical operations of Willow’s programs: daily huddle, escalation pathway, after-hours protocol, and the clinical standards that govern on-call and coverage.
  • Triage and resolve clinical escalations from the care team; serve as the final clinical decision-maker on urgent matters within the scope set by the CMO.
  • Work closely with the clinical supervisors and the clinical operations team on capacity, scheduling, and coverage — setting the clinical parameters they plan against, including safe caseload ranges, acuity mix, supervision ratios, and prescriber availability requirements.
  • Review panel distribution and acuity on an ongoing basis with clinical operations and the supervisors, and raise capacity or acuity mismatches before they affect access, provider sustainability, or safety.
  • Escalate to the Chief Medical Officer where clinical safety parameters and operational capacity needs conflict and cannot be resolved between the Medical Director and clinical operations; the CMO holds the decision.
  • Partner with clinical supervisors so that supervision, case conference, and quality expectations are applied consistently across teams and programs.
  • Ensure continuity across transitions — intake to program, program to step-down, and discharge to community provider.

    • Quality, safety, and outcomes

  • Lead clinical quality and safety review: adverse and near-miss events, root cause analysis, and corrective action.
  • Use Willow's clinical oversight dashboard — patient safety, provider load, engagement and retention, clinical outcomes, therapeutic alliance, and population demographics — to direct clinical intervention, and give the CMO clinical input.
  • Attend clinical quality committee and contribute to peer review.

    • Clinical standards and compliance

  • Maintain and update clinical protocols, standing orders, and documentation templates in partnership with the CMO and the Compliance Officer.
  • Support state regulatory and licensure requirements applicable to our programs.
  • Ensure prescribing practice — including controlled substances delivered via telehealth — meets federal and state requirements.

    • Growth and team building

  • Interview, select, and onboard psychiatric prescribers as the medical staff grows.
  • Contribute clinical design to new tracks, new populations, and new market launches.
  • Represent Willow clinically to hospital partners, referral sources, and payers when asked.

Qualifications

    Required

  • MD or DO with completed ACGME-accredited psychiatry residency.
  • Board certified in psychiatry by the ABPN.
  • Active, unrestricted medical licenses in New York and North Carolina, or the ability to obtain the second license within 90 days.
  • Active DEA registration.
  • Minimum three years of post-residency clinical practice.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising or collaborating with nurse practitioners.
  • Direct experience with acute or crisis psychiatry — emergency psychiatry, consult-liaison, inpatient, partial hospitalization, ACT or mobile crisis.
  • Comfort practicing and leading in a telehealth environment.

    • Preferred

  • Board certification or substantive experience in addiction psychiatry, child and adolescent psychiatry.
  • Prior medical director or clinical leadership role, ideally in a growth-stage or startup setting.
  • Familiarity with Medicaid behavioral health delivery in New York or North Carolina.

What We're Looking For

  • We are early. Protocols are being written, not maintained.
  • The right person is a strong clinician who is energizedrather than frustrated by that — someone who will build the standard, hold the team to it, and stay close enoughto the work to know whether it is actually being met.
  • You should be decisive under acuity, direct with colleagues,and willing to say when a patient is not safe to keep in our program.

Benefits for Our Team

  • PTO includes sick leave, certain federal holidays, and vacation
  • Continuing education time and stipend
  • 401K
  • Health insurance
  • Malpractice liability insurance
  • Multidisciplinary team collaboration

Willow Health is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

About The Role:

We’re hiring an Associate Demand Generation Manager to build and run the demand engine for our Corporate Tech business.

Our Corporate Tech team has found strong product-market fit with one of our most differentiated datasets among some of the largest and fastest-growing technology companies in the world. This has quickly become a meaningful growth driver for the business and to go after it more aggressively, we’re dedicating resources towards unlocking more opportunities in this space.

You’ll partner directly with Corporate Tech leadership to define a tiered list of target accounts, then orchestrate account-based programs that get us into those accounts: multi-threaded plays across buying committees, content and social proof built for a focused set of buyers, and coordinated execution across paid, organic, events, and sales outreach. You’ll have the rare advantage of using proprietary data these companies have never seen before to earn their attention and get them to raise their hands. You’ll shape how a specific, high-value market perceives YipitData, and you’ll own the pipeline that results.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Marketing directly contributes a growing number of sales-accepted opportunities (SAOs) within priority accounts.
  • Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline and closed-won revenue in Corporate Tech grow quarter over quarter against defined targets, pulling forward revenue that would have taken longer to capture without marketing support.
  • Account penetration deepens: more engaged contacts across more roles within each target account.
  • Sales has a steady flow of warm, well-educated conversations, and a tight feedback loop with marketing on what’s working.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Associate Demand Generation Manager You Will:

  • Own the tiered target account list in partnership with Corporate Tech leadership, defining ideal customer profiles, buying committee personas, and prioritization criteria for both known and whitespace accounts.
  • Orchestrate 1:1 and 1:few account-based marketing plays that reach multiple stakeholders within each buying committee, sequencing content, outreach, and offers across channels to move accounts from awareness to active conversation.
  • Own content strategy and the editorial roadmap for the Corporate Tech audience in partnership with our Content Marketing Associate, ensuring every asset is anchored in differentiated data and built to open doors.
  • Direct channel execution across paid social, paid search, retargeting, organic, and AEO in partnership with our Digital Marketing Associate, with targeting and messaging tuned to priority accounts.
  • Partner with marketing leadership on our social proof strategy for target accounts, surfacing testimonials, case studies, and customer stories and putting them in front of the right buyers at the right stage.
  • Shape event strategy in partnership with our Associate Field Marketing Manager, including hosted events, executive roundtables, and third-party conferences where target accounts are present.
  • Partner closely with Sales on outbound strategy, messaging, and positioning, arming the team with account insights, sequences, and data-led talking points.
  • Support expansion motions within existing Corporate Tech accounts, identifying new teams and use cases and running programs to unlock them.
  • Own measurement and performance for the program, building the reporting that connects account engagement to SAOs, pipeline, and closed-won revenue and sharing results and tradeoffs across the company.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn cadence on audiences, offers, channels, and messaging, and scale what works.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, account-based marketing, or growth marketing, with a track record of sourcing pipeline and revenue from a defined set of target accounts. Experience marketing to enterprise technology companies, or marketing data, analytics, or research products, is a strong plus.
  • You’ve built and run ABM programs end to end, from account selection and persona mapping through multi-channel orchestration and measurement.
  • You’re fluent in the modern ABM demand gen stack
  • You have strong messaging instincts and can translate a complex data product into a sharp, buyer-specific reason to take a meeting.
  • You work exceptionally well with Sales and treat the relationship as a true partnership, with shared targets and a fast feedback loop.
  • You’re an operator who can orchestrate across content, digital, field, and sales partners, keeping many moving parts aligned toward a single goal.
  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, bias toward action, and are energized by building a program from the ground up.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary Only: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $110K-130K. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Job Summary

About us

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is the observability platform built for control in the modern, containerized world. Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours. Our team enables customers to systematically test, measure, and benchmark AI agents and applications before deployment and monitor how they behave in production. We turn complex telemetry and evaluation data into insights that help developers build and operate reliable AI agents and applications at scale.

We are looking for experienced engineers with a strong product sense who asks “why” as often as “how”. About Us

A Fortune 500® company, EMCOR Group, Inc. (NYSE: EME) is a leader in mechanical and electrical construction, industrial and energy infrastructure, and building services. EMCOR companies plan, install, operate, maintain, and protect the sophisticated and dynamic systems that create facility environments—such as electrical, mechanical, lighting, air conditioning, heating, security, fire protection, and power generation systems—in virtually every sector of the economy and for a diverse range of businesses, organizations, and government.

Job Summary

The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting practical artificial intelligence solutions that improve business processes, increase productivity, and enable responsible AI adoption across EMCOR. This hands-on role will build and integrate AI capabilities, including generative AI applications, automation workflows, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, AI agents, and model-enabled business processes. The AI Engineer will partner directly with EMCOR Operating Companies and corporate departments to identify use cases, develop reusable patterns, support implementation efforts, and help teams adopt AI capabilities in a secure, scalable, and supportable manner. This role will also work closely with the AI Security Engineer to ensure AI solutions follow approved security architecture, data protection requirements, governance processes, and responsible AI standards. This role reports to the VP of Information Technology and is fully remote.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The principal duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI-enabled solutions that address business needs across EMCOR and its Operating Companies
  • Build practical AI capabilities including generative AI applications, AI agents, workflow automation, document intelligence, natural language interfaces, and retrieval-augmented generation solutions
  • Partner with Operating Company leaders, corporate departments, and IT teams to identify high-value AI use cases, define requirements, prototype solutions, and support implementation
  • Create reusable AI solution patterns, implementation guidance, technical documentation, and reference examples that Operating Companies can adopt and extend
  • Integrate AI capabilities with approved enterprise platforms, applications, APIs, data sources, and automation tools
  • Develop and maintain prompt engineering standards, evaluation approaches, testing routines, and quality controls for AI outputs
  • Work with the AI Security Engineer to ensure AI solutions meet EMCOR security requirements, including data protection, access control, logging, monitoring, prompt and response filtering, and approved architecture patterns
  • Ensure AI solution development follows EMCOR Secure Software Development Lifecycle guidelines, including security requirements, design reviews, secure coding practices, testing, validation, documentation, and release readiness
  • Support AI governance processes by documenting solution purpose, data sources, risks, controls, expected outputs, limitations, and operational ownership
  • Monitor implemented AI solutions for performance, reliability, usage, cost, quality, and business value; recommend improvements as needed
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies, enterprise AI platforms, development frameworks, and implementation best practices; translate relevant advancements into practical EMCOR use cases
  • Provide training, guidance, and practical support to EMCOR employees on the effective and responsible use of approved AI tools, including appropriate use cases, prompting and development, productivity best practices, and data protection requirements.

Qualifications

  • Five years minimum experience in software engineering, application development, data engineering, automation, or related technology implementation roles
  • Two years minimum hands-on experience developing or implementing AI, machine learning, generative AI, automation, or advanced analytics solutions
  • Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, or SQL
  • Working knowledge of generative AI concepts, large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, and AI solution evaluation
  • Experience integrating applications, data sources, APIs, automation workflows, and cloud services
  • Deep experience with Microsoft 365 Chat and Agents, Azure AI, Power Platform (power user/admin AND AI Builder), Copilot Studio, GitHub, M365 Copilot and Agents, Foundry and 1P Agents or comparable enterprise AI and development platforms strongly preferred
  • Understanding of data protection, access control, Secure Software Development Lifecycle guidelines, secure development practices, and responsible AI principles
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to effectively communicate and interact with personnel at all levels, including EMCOR executive management, operating company leadership, IT teams, Security, Legal, Risk, and other business users
  • Must be capable of delivering a very high level of customer service

Job Title: Software Engineering Manager

Location: Remote – US

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Direct and mentor a cross-functional team of software engineers and contractors. You are responsible for career growth, performance management, and resource allocation.
  • Project Execution: Own the delivery lifecycle for OS features. You’ll manage timelines, risks, and dependencies, ensuring that "moving fast" never comes at the expense of "moving safely."
  • Stakeholder Requirements: Act as the primary technical interface with external customers and internal stakeholders to capture, analyze, and refine operational capabilities into structured, actionable systems and software requirements.
  • Regulatory & Airworthiness Compliance: Deep-dive into complex aerospace and safety-critical technical standards to translate rigorous certification requirements into clear, executable engineering actionable items.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a management role.
  • The ability to translate complex technical hurdles into clear project status updates for stakeholders.
  • Deep expertise in SCRUM/Agile. You know how to make Agile work in environments where "breaking things" isn't an option.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field preferred.
  • Must be a US Citizen.

Highly desired additional experience:

  • Exposure to safety-critical development processes (DO-178C, ISO 26262).
  • Experience developing systems-level software, including virtualization, OS kernels, or hypervisors for x86/ARM.

  • Remote work opportunities based on role

What you'll do

  • Paid media and lead generation
    • Own ZRG's paid media strategy and execution across all channels - paid search (PPC/SEM), paid social (LinkedIn, programmatic), content syndication, intent-based targeting, and display - with a relentless focus on cost-efficient lead and pipeline generation.
    • Set channel strategy, be accountable to budgets set by the Director, GTM Operations, and hold agencies and platforms accountable to performance against UQL, MQL, meeting, cost-per-lead, cost-per-meeting, and pipeline contribution targets.
    • Build and continuously optimize full-funnel paid programs that drive both awareness and direct response, ensuring every dollar works harder over time.
    • Oversee landing page strategy, conversion rate optimization, and A/B testing frameworks to maximize the yield from paid investment.
    • Leverage new techniques around AI-driven market signals – UQLs – and generating nurture strategies to convert those into qualified leads.
  • Cross-sell and post-hire engagement
    • Execute against ZRG's post-hire engagement marketing strategy – starting with our Role Call program - ensuring that clients who hire through one ZRG service line are exposed to, educated on, and converted to others.
    • Build nurture programs and campaigns that keep ZRG visible and relevant to existing clients across the full lifecycle, from placement through retention and expansion.
    • Partner with client success, delivery, and account teams to identify cross-sell moments and turn them into scalable, repeatable marketing programs.
    • Define and track metrics that connect engagement marketing activity to expanded client relationships and incremental revenue.
  • Business unit Marketing partnership
    • Serve as the performance marketing lead for ZRG's four business units - executive search, embedded recruiting, consulting, and interim - partnering with each Business Unit Marketing Director to align demand generation strategy with commercial priorities.
    • Translate business unit goals into channel-specific paid and owned media plans, ensuring each line of business has the pipeline coverage it needs. Own the goals on behalf of each of these BUs.
    • Bring a consistent performance marketing framework across business units while allowing for the nuance each segment requires.
    • Own and drive the end-to-end SEO strategy, including keyword research, search intent mapping, and optimization to align organic search initiatives with business and marketing goals
    • Lead execution across technical, on-page, and content SEO, partnering cross-functionally to embed best practices across digital channels
  • Owned channels and marketing automation
    • Lead the strategy and optimization of ZRG's owned channels - email, marketing automation, website, and organic social - as demand generation and lead nurture assets.
    • Own the roadmap for ZRG's marketing automation platform (Pardot/Salesforce Marketing Cloud), including lead scoring, segmentation, nurture flows, and CRM integration.
    • Ensure owned channels are working in concert with paid investment to deliver qualified leads and booked meetings efficiently.
    • Partner with content and brand teams to ensure owned channel messaging is powerful, differentiated, and conversion-oriented.
  • Analytics, reporting, and optimization
    • Build and maintain the performance marketing measurement framework, defining the KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
    • Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reviews with clear attribution, insights, and optimization actions.
    • Drive a culture of testing and iteration, across creative, copy, audience, channel, and offer, with disciplined experimentation and clear learning agendas.
    • Manage, report and be accountable to budget across media, agencies, tools and vendor support
    • Partner with revenue operations and sales leadership to ensure lead handoff, attribution, and funnel visibility are accurate and actionable.
  • Team and agency leadership
    • Directly manage the Manager of Performance Marketing and provide leadership, development, and clear direction as the team grows.
    • Own the relationships with agency partners, media buyers, and external contractors, setting expectations, managing performance, and ensuring alignment with ZRG's strategy and standards.
    • Leverage technology and AI to drive results, with human oversight and analysis at every touchpoint
    • In partnership with GTM Operations, build the team structure, hiring plan, and operating model to support ZRG's growth trajectory.
    • Foster a high-performance, test-and-learn culture where accountability and creativity coexist.

Who you are

  • A senior performance marketer with 8+ years of experience across paid media, demand generation, and marketing operations - ideally in B2B professional services, SaaS, or a similarly complex, consultative sales environment.
  • Proven ability to drive pipeline and revenue through paid and owned channels, with deep fluency in paid search, paid social, programmatic, and marketing automation.
  • You own results. You sweat the details. You earnestly and deeply desire and drive outcomes – not just checklist completion.
  • Experienced in cross-sell and lifecycle marketing - you understand how to use marketing to expand existing relationships, not just acquire new ones.
  • A strong collaborator who can work alongside business unit leaders, sales teams, and commercial partners to align marketing to revenue goals without losing sight of execution.
  • Analytically rigorous - you know your numbers, build your own reports when needed, and use data to make decisions and tell stories.
  • An experienced people leader and agency manager who can develop talent, hold partners accountable, and build a high-functioning team.
  • A trusted advisor who takes the extra time to explain the details and does the right thing for the people and the business.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the opportunity to build something - you don't need a fully built playbook to get started.

Why ZRG

ZRG is at an inflection point. We're growing fast, our service portfolio is expanding, and performance marketing is one of the most important levers we have. This is a rare opportunity to own a function with real commercial impact, build a team from an early stage, and leave a visible mark on how a market-leading talent advisory firm grows. If you want to do meaningful work, lead a function that matters, and be part of a team that moves fast and wins together - this is the role.

Compensation is tailored to each individual based on their skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The rates mentioned in this posting represent only the base hourly, monthly, or annual pay and exclude potential bonuses, equity, or sales incentives, where applicable. Beyond base pay, we provide a comprehensive benefits package.

ZRG Partners is Mac preferred environment.

raw.excerpt: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.
raw.description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide are chronically absent, making chronic absenteeism one of the highest-stakes challenges districts face. Attendance affects funding, academic outcomes, and long-term student success.

ParentSquare Attendance Plus is our answer: a proactive, relationship-driven solution built directly into the platform districts already use, giving attendance teams tiered data insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place. Since launching, Attendance Plus has earned industry recognition, including Tech & Learning's Best of 2025, and has become one of the fastest-growing lines in the ParentSquare platform.

We are not just creating products; we are creating empowered educators and engaged families to improve the lives of students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and our employees, and we invite you to join us on this journey.

Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who will own the market strategy for Attendance Plus. You'll go deep on the chronic absenteeism problem itself—the research, the district budget cycles, the competitive landscape—and use that expertise to shape where Attendance Plus goes next.

You'll own positioning and messaging for the entire attendance line, translate the needs of attendance clerks, counselors, and district administrators into a narrative that resonates through the whole buying committee, and make the call on which capabilities deserve a full go-to-market push versus a quiet rollout. You'll partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on packaging, pricing, and competitive strategy for the line.

Success in this role means the market understands why Attendance Plus is different, our go-to-market teams know how to win attendance conversations, and customer and competitive insights consistently shape what we build and how we take it to market. You'll be accountable not just for launches but also for helping to grow Attendance Plus as a business.

In This Role You'll:

  • Own the market strategy for Attendance Plus
    • Own positioning and messaging for Attendance Plus, translating chronic absenteeism research and district pain points into a value proposition that’s aligned internally and resonates with superintendents, student services, attendance clerks, and school boards alike.
    • Become an internal expert on the attendance and chronic absenteeism market, including state-level attendance-based funding formulas, district budget cycles, buying dynamics, emerging trends, and the competitive landscape.
    • Partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on pricing, packaging, and segmentation for the line, bringing the voice of the market into build and prioritization conversations.
    • Identify the highest-potential segments, use cases, and growth opportunities for Attendance Plus and develop strategies to reach them.
  • Drive go-to-market for roadmap
    • Work with GTM teams to execute plans for new Attendance Plus capabilities, determining the level of investment a release earns based on its strategic weight to the line.
    • Define launch goals and success metrics, then use adoption, customer feedback, field insights, and market response to evaluate performance and inform what comes next.
    • Turn win/loss analysis and customer research into clear insights on why we win, where we lose, and what those insights mean for our product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Enable the field on attendance
    • Partner with Sales Enablement to help the Sales and Customer Success teams win attendance opportunities, including competitive battlecards, buyer-specific messaging, ROI and outcomes framing, and objection handling.
    • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams to confidently communicate new capabilities, positioning shifts, competitive differentiation, and responses to objections.
  • Lead proactively and drive alignment
    • Drive alignment across the Attendance product team, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership, bringing stakeholders together around a shared understanding of the market and a clear narrative for how we win.
    • Surface strategic risks and opportunities early and turn those insights into clear recommendations.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • Has at least 8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of strategy, positioning, and go-to-market for a specific product or line of business.
  • A proven track record of rapidly scaling a new product line through a complex expansion motion that reaches new buyers within existing customer accounts.
  • Brings exceptional drive, high standards, and a winning mindset, with the ability to earn executive sponsorship while building adoption among frontline stakeholders.
  • Has a track record of using customer, market, and competitive insight to influence product or business decisions.
  • Has strong storytelling and written communication skills and can turn complex customer problems and product capabilities into simple, differentiated narratives.
  • Experience with win/loss analysis, customer research, and translating qualitative insight into clear recommendations.
  • Has genuine interest in the chronic absenteeism problem space and willingness to become the internal expert on it.
  • Is willing to travel to industry events and conferences to spend time with customers, prospects, and the broader education community (approximately 20% travel)

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $120,000-$165,000 DOE.

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. They need someone in their corner who knows their name, understands their situation, and is actively fighting to get them the best possible outcome. The Case Manager exists to be that person, a dedicated advocate who owns the client relationship completely and ensures no one ever feels like just a file number. When this role is done right, clients feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is genuinely working for them.

What You Will Own

  • Own the client relationship from day one through settlement, the Welcome Call is yours, the relationship is yours, and the outcome is yours
  • Be the client's dedicated advocate, connecting them to the right care fast and walking them through one of the most stressful experiences of their life with confidence and compassion
  • Drive cases forward with urgency, moving through each phase with precision and purpose
  • Build demand packages that tell a compelling story and negotiate toward outcomes that make a real difference for real people
  • Be the source of truth on every case you touch, leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay sharp, move fast, and never let anything slip
  • This is not a hand-off role, it's full ownership, and for the right person, it's one of the most impactful seats in the firm

What You Bring

Required:

  • 2–6 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in Arkansas
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor's degree or Paralegal Certificate
  • Experience in a high-volume or fast-growing law firm
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
CrowdStrike is seeking a high-performing Strategic Partner Business Development Manager to accelerate growth across our strategic Global Systems Integrator (GSI) ecosystem in Europe.

This is a highly strategic, field-facing role responsible for driving measurable pipeline and bookings growth through partner engagement, strategic opportunity development and joint go-to-market execution. Working closely with CrowdStrike Sales, Alliances, Marketing and Services teams, as well as partner sales and leadership, you will identify, qualify, develop and help execute strategic customer pursuits while strengthening executive relationships and expanding partner-led growth.

Success in this role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution—building trusted relationships across executive, sales, technical and alliance organisations, activating partners in-market, creating demand, accelerating strategic opportunities and translating joint business plans into tangible business outcomes.

As a trusted advisor to both internal and external stakeholders, you will play a key role in expanding CrowdStrike’s market presence, increasing platform adoption and strengthening one of our most strategic routes to market across Europe.

What You’ll Do:

Drive Strategic Sales Growth

  • Identify, qualify, develop and support strategic joint sales pursuits that generate sustainable pipeline and bookings growth across the IGSI ecosystem in Europe.

  • Partner closely with CrowdStrike Account Executives, Regional Sales Leaders and partner sellers to originate, shape and accelerate complex enterprise opportunities from qualification through to close.

  • Drive disciplined opportunity management through regular pipeline inspection, pursuit planning and executive governance to maximise win rates.

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of strategic opportunities aligned to regional growth priorities and forecast commitments.

  • Support platform expansion opportunities across the CrowdStrike portfolio, including cross-sell and upsell initiatives that increase customer value and long-term recurring revenue.

Develop and Execute Joint Business Plans

  • Develop and execute strategic Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that align partner investment with CrowdStrike’s regional growth objectives.

  • Translate strategic priorities into measurable execution plans with clear KPIs around pipeline generation, bookings growth, partner activation, enablement, demand generation and executive engagement.

  • Regularly assess business performance and adapt plans to maximise growth opportunities and market impact.

  • Drive accountability across both organisations to ensure successful execution of agreed initiatives.

Activate the Field and Generate Demand

  • Develop and execute joint go-to-market initiatives that create qualified pipeline and accelerate partner-led revenue growth.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to build integrated demand generation campaigns, executive events, industry programmes and regional sales plays.

  • Drive joint account planning across strategic customers, aligning CrowdStrike and partner sales teams around target accounts and growth opportunities.

  • Increase field engagement by creating repeatable sales motions, facilitating introductions and enabling stronger collaboration between regional sales teams.

Strengthen Strategic Partner Relationships

  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships across executive, sales, technical, services, marketing and alliance organisations within assigned partners.

  • Build strong executive sponsorship and establish regular strategic interlocks that strengthen alignment, remove barriers and accelerate business outcomes.

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination for strategic initiatives between CrowdStrike and assigned partners across Europe.

  • Influence senior stakeholders to increase commitment, investment and executive visibility around joint growth priorities.

Expand Services and Solution Adoption

  • Work with partner leadership to expand CrowdStrike-powered services and managed offerings that drive customer adoption and partner profitability.

  • Identify opportunities to grow partner capabilities through enablement, certification, solution development and services alignment.

  • Support strategic initiatives that increase adoption of Falcon Flex and accelerate platform consolidation across enterprise customers.

  • Collaborate with Product, Services and Solution Engineering teams to enable differentiated partner-led customer outcomes.

Deliver Operational Excellence

  • Lead executive business reviews, quarterly planning sessions and performance reviews with assigned partners.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We're changing how the world moves money. Wallets are where that change becomes real: the first place millions of people truly own their money. You'll own design execution across our wallets, working directly with the Design Lead to shape where they go next.

Responsibilities

  • Own design execution end to end: from concept and prototype to launch and iteration.

  • Turn complex, conceptual ideas into experiences that feel simple to someone using a wallet for the first time.

  • Prototype fast and often: high-fidelity and interactive, in days not weeks, using the best tools available, AI included.

  • Partner daily with product, engineering and research, and present your work clearly to leadership.

  • Raise the bar for quality across everything we ship.

  • Contribute to strategic decisions about the future of our wallets.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with real time shipping live products in wallets, crypto or fintech.

  • Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including AI tools to accelerate ideation.

  • A working understanding of crypto networks, fees and self-custody, and how they shape what users experience.

  • A plain-language instinct: you make complex things feel obvious.

  • You thrive in a genuinely fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment. We ship weekly.

  • Experience designing for emerging markets or first-time financial users is a nice to have.

  • Design systems experience at scale is a nice to have.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

Alliance Solutions Group is a leading Sage Intacct partner for the construction industry and a fast-growing, PE-backed professional services organization. As Alliance continues to scale, we are investing in the leadership, infrastructure, and insights needed to support our next stage of growth.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to serve as a strategic business partner to our leadership team and help shape how we plan, measure, and make decisions across the business. This role sits at the intersection of financial planning, business intelligence, and business strategy—translating financial and operational data into clear insights that help leaders understand performance, evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions.

The right leader will bring an Alliance-first mindset and a strong understanding of how Finance can enable the broader business. They will partner closely with leaders across the organization, bring a thoughtful financial perspective to strategic conversations, and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance and create value. Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between the details and the bigger picture—building strong financial discipline while helping Alliance scale with confidence.

This is a fully remote role with quarterly travel for Leadership offsites and report directly to the CEO and sit on the Executive Leadership team.

Read more about the Alliance Team in our People Behind the Build Blog Series.

What You’ll Own

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the leadership team, bringing a financial and business perspective to company planning, investment decisions, organizational priorities, and growth initiatives.
  • Act as the financial business partner to department leaders, developing a deep understanding of their operations, challenges, and opportunities. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make stronger, faster decisions.
  • Work closely with the Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness on workforce and organizational planning, including headcount strategy, organizational design, role changes, and resource allocation. Together, connect the financial and people implications of organizational decisions to ensure investments support both business performance and long-term scalability.
  • Bring financial rigor to strategic initiatives and new opportunities. Build business cases, model scenarios, assess ROI and risk, and clearly articulate tradeoffs so leadership can make informed decisions about where and how Alliance invests for growth.

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own the company’s financial planning and forecasting framework, including the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning, and monthly performance reporting. Ensure leadership has a clear and forward-looking view of financial performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Build financial models and business cases that inform strategic decisions, including investments, new offerings, organizational changes, headcount planning, and other growth initiatives. Translate complex scenarios into clear financial implications and actionable recommendations.
  • Own performance against key financial and commercial targets, including EBITDA, partner incentives, recurring revenue, and other strategic metrics. Identify emerging risks and opportunities early and proactively bring recommendations to leadership.
  • Connect financial planning to the broader strategic plan, ensuring budgets and forecasts reflect the company’s priorities, growth expectations, resource needs, and evolving business model.
  • Partner with the CEO on board and investor reporting, developing clear financial narratives and materials that communicate performance, outlook, key drivers, and strategic priorities..

Controller & Order Processing Oversight

  • Lead, develop and partner with the Controller and broader Finance team, establishing strong operating rhythms, controls, reporting standards, and accountability across the function. Ensure accurate, timely financial reporting and continuously improve the efficiency and scalability of Finance operations.
  • Oversee the financial components of the order-to-revenue lifecycle, ensuring accurate deal booking, billing readiness, provisioning coordination, and strong handoffs across Sales, Finance, and Delivery as the company’s offerings and deal structures become more complex.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance systems, processes, and automation, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, strengthen data integrity, reduce manual effort, and build infrastructure that can scale with the business.

Revenue & Business Intelligence

  • Own revenue and commercial analytics at the strategic level, providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health, bookings, revenue performance, renewals, retention, and churn. Go beyond reporting what happened to identifying why it happened and what we should do next.
  • Lead deeper analysis of the drivers behind company performance, including customer and product segmentation, retention and churn trends, expansion opportunities, service-line economics, and other areas that can unlock profitable growth.
  • Support pricing, packaging, and investment decisions by developing financial models that evaluate economics, scalability, ROI, and potential business impact.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership on forecasting and pipeline analytics, strengthening the connection between commercial activity and financial outcomes and improving the predictability of future performance.

What You Bring

Qualifications

  • 7–12+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or finance leadership, ideally within a PE-backed, high-growth, or professional services environment but required.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, with the ability to independently build and evaluate multi-year forecasts, investment and ROI models, pricing scenarios, and complex business cases.
  • Strategic and commercial mindset that extends beyond Finance. You understand how the pieces of a business connect and can translate financial performance, operational dynamics, and market opportunities into thoughtful recommendations for growth.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to distill complex financial information into clear, compelling insights and recommendations for senior leadership, investors, and board-level audiences.
  • Proven leadership capability, with experience developing high-performing teams, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability while empowering others to own their work. You lead with sound judgment, humility, and self-awareness.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward action. You are energized by building and evolving functions, proactively identifying opportunities, and creating structure where needed. You are comfortable operating in a growing organization where priorities evolve and leaders are expected to help shape the path forward.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience within professional services, SaaS, construction technology, or channel/partner-based business models.
  • Experience working in a PE-backed environment and familiarity with investor reporting, value-creation initiatives, and the pace and rigor of private-equity ownership.
  • Familiarity with Sage Intacct or similar cloud-based financial management platforms.
  • Exposure to AI, automation, or technology-enabled business transformation, particularly where technology is being used to improve operating leverage or create new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience supporting M&A, due diligence, integration, or strategic acquisitions.
  • A background that combines strong quantitative thinking with business strategy—whether through finance, economics, engineering, or another analytically rigorous discipline.

Company Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation plan
  • Medical, Dental, Vision coverage offered
  • Supplemental insurance options available
  • 401K Safe Harbor Match
  • Paid Military Leave
  • Paid Maternity Leave
  • Generous personal time off policy
  • Twelve Company paid holidays
  • Flex Friday – off one Friday per month (not deducted from PTO)

At Alliance Solutions Group , our values are more than just words—they are the foundation of everything we do. They guide how we collaborate, innovate, and serve our clients while fostering a culture of accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement. These principles ensure that every decision we make aligns with our mission, empowers our team, and strengthens our long-term relationships with customers. By living these values every day, we drive success for both our company and the clients who trust us.

  • Velocity: we are built to move fast and constantly improve
  • Collaboration: this is a team sport and we put the mission first
  • Innovation: we are trusted by our clients for our leadership in technology
  • Extreme Ownership: we are accountable to each other and for ASG’s outcomes
  • Client-Centric: we are building lifetime relationships with customer

If you seek a collaborative environment where no two days are alike, if you want a place to grow with a company that is growing with you, if you want to be respected for your expertise while expanding your skill set, and if you want to work hard in an environment where relationships are enjoyed, ALLIANCE SOLUTIONS GROUP, LLC is the place for you.

Alliance Solutions Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

raw.description:
Two Opportunities!

We have two Team Lead openings — one in Property Claims and one in General Liability. The shared responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations are outlined below. Role-specific details for each position are at the bottom of this posting. When you apply, please indicate which role you are interested in.

Opening 1 – Ryze

Property Claims Team Lead

Opening 2 - Certus

General Liability Claims Team Lead

About the Role

Both Team Lead openings are working lead roles — you carry an active claim portfolio while providing day-to-day guidance, oversight, and mentorship to the team around you. You are the first point of escalation for complex coverage and claim handling questions, and a direct extension of Claims Manager and Director-level leadership.

The right person for either role is a seasoned adjuster who is ready to take on real leadership responsibility without stepping away from the work. If you have been the person your teammates come to when things get complicated, this is your next step.

What You'll Do

Claim Handling

  • Manage an active portfolio of claims from report to resolution, consistent with client guidelines and company direction.
  • Examine policies and records to determine coverage and document positions clearly.
  • Conduct thorough investigations per claim handling guidelines and best practices.
  • Estimate costs, prepare reports of findings, and negotiate settlements.
  • Respond to all communications — emails, voicemails, client forms — within required timeframes.
  • Assist with escalations and reassignments across the team as directed.

Team Leadership and Coaching

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for team members on complex coverage, liability, and negotiation questions.
  • Review team work product for quality, accuracy, and consistency with client and company standards.
  • Provide day-to-day mentorship and coaching to adjusters on your team.
  • Identify skill gaps and partner with management and training to address them.
  • Support onboarding of new team members through file reviews and real-time guidance.
  • Monitor workloads and flag capacity or quality concerns to management proactively.
  • Model the standards of professionalism, production, and client service expected across the team.

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide ongoing feedback to management on team performance, file status, and emerging issues.
  • Assist management with client reporting and communication as needed.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement at the process and procedure level.

What We're Looking For

Required for both roles:

  • Active adjuster license in applicable states.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including policy interpretation.
  • Sound decision-making and ability to work independently.
  • Analytical and proactive approach to claim handling.
  • Proficient in MS Office: Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading other adjusters.

Preferred for both roles:

  • Prior formal lead, senior, or supervisory experience in a claims environment.
  • Previous TPA experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with multi-carrier environments and varying client guidelines.
  • Ability to speak Spanish a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your own portfolio closes on time and meets quality standards consistently.
  • Team members have a reliable resource for hard questions and leave those conversations with a clear path forward.
  • Escalations to management are well-framed, documented, and come with a recommendation.
  • Adjusters on your team improve measurably under your guidance.
  • Client and carrier feedback reflects the professionalism and responsiveness RYZE is known for.

ROLE-SPECIFIC DETAILS

Opening 1: Property Claims Team Lead

The Property Claims Team Lead manages a portfolio of daily property claims while leading a team of Desk Adjusters. This role sits one level above Desk Adjuster II and is the natural next step for a high-performing property adjuster ready to take on leadership responsibility.

Additional requirements for this role:

  • 7+ years of property claim handling experience, with demonstrated senior-level performance.
  • Xactimate proficiency required.
  • Prior experience as a Desk Adjuster II or equivalent senior individual contributor role.

What makes this role distinct:

  • Property-focused claim portfolio — daily losses from report to resolution.
  • High production environment with statutory timeframe accountability.
  • Xactimate-driven estimating and settlement negotiation.

Opening 2: General Liability Claims Team Lead

The General Liability Claims Team Lead manages a portfolio of third-party Bodily Injury and Property Damage claims — litigated and non-litigated — while leading a team of GL Claims Examiners. This role requires deep knowledge of coverage, liability evaluation, and litigation management across a GL book of business.

Additional requirements for this role:

  • 5 to 7 years of General Liability claims handling experience, including Bodily Injury and Property Damage.
  • 1 to 2 years of team management or leadership experience.
  • Experience with both litigated and non-litigated claims.
  • Mediation and settlement negotiation experience.
  • Experience collaborating with defense counsel on litigated matters.

What makes this role distinct:

  • GL-focused claim portfolio — third-party BI and PD, litigated and non-litigated.
  • Direct coordination with defense counsel on complex and litigated matters.
  • Mediation attendance and settlement authority on high-exposure files.
  • Carrier compliance and reporting cadence responsibilities.
